organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna, Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is an annual running event offering both competitive and recreational categories over half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km distances. All races start at 13:00 from three different locations along National Road 34 between Linköping and Motala, and finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is organised by Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna and Vreta SoMK, and welcomes runners of different ages and abilities. Buses transport participants from the finish area to the start locations before the race. Late registration is available at the start locations for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Mass start from Ljungsbro, Sjöbacka bridge and Brunneby Musteri
Finish at the Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
Bus transport from the finish to the start locations before the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the respective start location before the start. Late registration takes place at the start locations between 11:30 and 12:30, with a 50% surcharge on the regular fee. Medals are free for participants aged 16 and under; others can buy a medal at the finish. Refreshments are available at the finish area. The distances are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners, with membership required for the competitive category. Registration is via the web, with payment by Swish or bank giro. The race has a long tradition and attracts around 360 participants each year.

name: SäterMaran inkl. DM i halvmaraton
description: SäterMaran is an annual running event in Säter that includes the district championships in the half marathon. The event offers several distances, including the half marathon and 10 km, and welcomes runners of different levels. It is organized by Säters IF FIK and is known for its friendly atmosphere, focus on the joy of running, and sense of local community.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km distances
Low participation in the full marathon, with a focus on the half marathon and 10 km
Held in Säter amid scenic surroundings
additional: Late registration for the full marathon is closed due to low participation, but registration for the half marathon and 10 km remains open as usual.

name: Tradicinės bėgimo varžybos „Senvagė-2026“
location: Senvagė and Kultūros ir poilsio parkas, Panevėžys, Lithuania
description: The traditional “Senvagė-2026” running competition is part of a Lithuanian Running Cup stage and takes place in Panevėžys, in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park. The event brings together running enthusiasts from various cities to promote sports, a healthy lifestyle, and the discovery of the natural and cultural beauty of Lithuania’s regions. The competition is part of the long-standing Lithuanian Running Cup tradition, which has brought together professional and amateur runners across the country since 2009. The event takes place in spring, giving participants the opportunity to enjoy nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: The competition takes place in Senvagė and Culture and Recreation Park in Panevėžys
A traditional Lithuanian Running Cup stage featuring runners from various cities
Encourages participants to discover the nature and architecture of Lithuania’s regions
additional: Registration is managed by VšĮ Bėgimo taurė. The entry fee is non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Participants may change their distance or transfer their registration to another person no later than the close of advance registration. If changing from a more expensive to a less expensive distance, the price difference is non-refundable. The participant change fee is 10 euros. The event will take place at Kranto g. 24, Panevėžys, with online registration available.

name: Komian kirkon hölkkä
description: Komian Kirkon Jog is a running event organized by Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry in the Ylistaro area. The event offers a variety of distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, on scenic routes with changing landscapes. It is popular with locals and offers a good opportunity to test your fitness in early spring. The event is part of Ylistaron Kilpa-Veljet ry’s active event calendar and orienteering activities.
course_highlights: Varied routes: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon
Beautiful and diverse terrain in the Ylistaro area
Route maps available for the 5 km and half marathon/10 km routes
additional: Race instructions for runners, spectators, support crew and volunteer helpers are available on the race information page. Results and registered participants can be viewed online. Route maps are available in PDF format for the 5 km and half marathon/10 km routes. The event takes place on 4 April 2027 and includes various race and participation options. Results and more information are available on the event website.

name: Påsksmällen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 5 km 12:30 300:-

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Män och kvinnor öppen klass Landsväg 10 km 12:30 300:-

description: Påsksmällen is a classic road and cross-country race organised by Enhörna IF, starting and finishing at Enhörna Friluftsgård. The race has a long tradition and offers several categories for both young people and adults. It is a welcoming event where participants can enjoy varied terrain and a wonderful running experience in scenic surroundings. Registration is in advance, with late registration available on site for an extra fee.
course_highlights: A combination of road and cross-country terrain
Start and finish at Enhörna Friluftsgård (sports ground)
Several youth categories with shorter distances
additional: Late registration on site is available until 60 minutes before each start, for an extra fee (SEK 100 for adult categories, SEK 50 for youth categories). The Swedish Athletics Federation’s competition rules apply. Participation is at your own risk. Names and any photos may be published on the club’s website and social media. The race includes several distances for children, young people and adults, with registration open until the day before the race and late registration available on site. Results and start lists are published on the club’s website and social media.

name: Varvetmilen - Jönköping
description: Varvetmilen Jönköping is a 10 km race that starts and finishes in Knektaparken. The course consists of two clockwise laps around scenic Lake Rocksjon and offers a wonderful running experience. Your Varvetmilen result can be used for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet, giving runners the chance to secure a better starting group. The race is organised by Göteborgsvarvet in cooperation with IKHP Huskvarna Idrottsklubb and is part of the Varvetmilen tour of Sweden.
course_highlights: Two clockwise laps around Lake Rocksjön
Start and finish in scenic Knektaparken
Qualifies for seeding at Göteborgsvarvet
additional: Race bib collection and bag drop take place at Knektaparken on race day. Minivarvet also takes place alongside Varvetmilen: a 210-metre race for children aged 0–6, with a medal for every participant. Registration for Minivarvet is available on site via Swish (80 kr). The race starts in Knektaparken and covers two laps around Lake Rocksjön. Race bibs can be collected the day before and on race day. Showers, changing facilities, bag storage and a small café are available on site.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
location: Studenternas IP, Uppsala, Uppsala Municipality, Sweden
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a recreational race for women, offering distances of 2.5 km and 5 km, with the start and finish at Studenternas IP. The event is all about the joy of movement and camaraderie, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ambition levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after crossing the finish line. Vårruset has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and offers an inclusive environment where women can feel safe and inspired to take part.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course
Start and finish at Studenternas IP, Ulleråkersvägen 6
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected May 3–5 at Intersport Boländerna. Picnics can be collected using the team captain’s race bib. The event area opens at 17:30, with a sponsor village and activities. There is a place to leave warm-up clothes and showers are available at the arena. Water stations and toilets are located at the start and finish. The recommended age is 11 for the 2.5 km distance (from age 7 when accompanied by an adult) and 13 for the 5 km distance (from age 11 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is binding and remains open until race day, up to 1 hour before the start. Optional timing is available, and all individual participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. The event is suitable for recreational runners and teams and is held in an inclusive atmosphere.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
price_range: 1600 kr långa banan, 1000 kr korta banan; efteranmälan 1900 kr och 1200 kr
description: Ölands Church Relay is a classic long-distance relay, held for the 47th time, offering a fantastic running experience on Öland in spring. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and there are two race options: a longer course with eleven legs totalling 67.5 km and a shorter course with six legs totalling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both experienced runners and beginners, with legs for all abilities. Organisers Högby IF and Ölands idrottskrets aim to provide the best possible service, with marshals, a race commentator and individual timing.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs ranging from 2.7 km to 8.5 km, 67.5 km in total
Short course: 6 legs ranging from 2.7 km to 5.4 km, 23.5 km in total
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing facilities and showers are available at the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead a group warm-up before the start. Marshals will be stationed along the course, at relay exchanges, and at the start and finish. Individual leg times, split times and team finish times are provided. A commentator will follow the race leaders from start to finish. Running on Öland, two course lengths, team categories, medal, barbecue plate, GPX files, changing facilities/showers, food/accommodation are offered.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp
price_range: 325 kronor (ordinarie), 195 kronor (kyrkundan), gratis för barnloppet, tillkommer 50 kronor för efteranmälan
description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby City Run is a popular running event featuring a scenic six-kilometre course through Mjölby, starting and finishing in Stadsparken. The course runs along the Svartån and includes both challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches, on an almost entirely asphalt surface. In addition to the main race, there is also Kyrkundan, approximately 3 km, and a free children’s race, Bostadsbolaget Lilla Stadsparksloppet. All participants who cross the finish line receive a medal in recognition of their achievement. The race is organised by Norrköpings Löparklubb in collaboration with IK Akele and Mjölby Cykelklubb.
course_highlights: 6 km course starting and finishing in Stadsparken, Mjölby
Runs along the Svartån for most of the route; 99% asphalt
Includes challenging climbs and enjoyable downhill stretches
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport Mjölby on Friday 8 May from 12:00 to 18:00, with a 25% discount coupon. The warm-up is led by Fitness4You before the start. Everyone who crosses the finish line receives a medal. The children’s race has four starts between 11:00 and 11:45, with age groups up to 12 years. The main race starts at 13:00 and Kyrkundan at 13:10. Late registration is available until 8 May for an additional fee of SEK 50. Massage is available in the start and finish area. The race takes place in Stadsparken, with options for company tents, registration via the website, race bib collection at Intersport Mjölby, and sponsorship.

name: Kungsholmen Runt
price_range: 100 kr rabatt för medlemmar, övriga priser ej specificerade
description: Kungsholmen Runt is a popular running race in Stockholm, offering both half-marathon and 10 km distances. The race follows flat courses around Kungsholmen, making it an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to set a personal best. The event is a celebration for all, with the start and finish in Rålambshovsparken, and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course around Kungsholmen
Start and finish in scenic Rålambshovsparken
The race offers both half-marathon and 10 km distances
additional: The race is a celebration for all, with flat courses suited to setting a personal best. There is also a children’s race. The start and finish are at Rålambshovsparken. Information about bus services and road closures is available for participants. Terrain around Kungsholmen, registration via link, children’s race for up to age 13

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a lovely spring race that runs along the beautiful Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred. The race offers a fantastic nature experience and a wonderful atmosphere, making it perfect for both beginners and experienced runners. It is a welcoming event that brings people together for exercise and community in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: Run along Lake Hulingen
Fantastic natural surroundings
Suitable for both beginners and experienced runners
additional: The race is held at Knektavallen, Folkparksvägen 3 in Hultsfred. It is a family-friendly event focused on exercise and health. No specific information about the price or entry fee is available on the website. The event includes a 10 km course and children’s races, and is open to everyone, regardless of club membership. Registration details are available on the website.

name: Björnlunken 2026
description: Björnlunken is a trail race that welcomes everyone, from children and recreational participants to experienced runners and mountain bikers. The race follows a scenic route through the pine-covered esker between Alberga and Kungsör, along trails and gravel roads with moderate hills and technical sections. The event has an open, welcoming atmosphere created together by volunteers, spectators and participants, and is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis. Many return year after year, while new participants take part for the first time.
course_highlights: Trail running and cycling along a pine-covered esker
Trails and gravel roads with moderate hills
Technical sections in nature between Alberga and Kungsör
additional: Late registration opens on the Thursday before race week. Start lists for pre-registered participants are available. The race is run by Kungsörs Sportklubb on a voluntary basis, with a strong sense of community among participants, volunteers and spectators.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vill du ha det bästa priset? Du vinner på att anmäla dig tidigt!

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Se prisstegen nedan. Priset avser kostnad per person.

description: Vårruset in Växjö is a fun run for women featuring 2.5 km and 5 km distances around the beautiful Lake Växjö. The event is all about the joy of running and community, and welcomes participants of all fitness backgrounds and ability levels. You can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event is part of a long-standing tradition dating back to 1989 and focuses on promoting women’s health and creating an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course around Lake Växjö
Start and finish at Strandbjörket
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport at Grand Samarkand in the days before the race. Bibs must be worn visibly throughout the race. You can opt out of timing. The event area has a water station, toilets, a café, and a sponsor village with activities. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Teams consist of 5 people and receive a picnic after the finish. The race is open to everyone, and participants can register individually or in teams of five. Women born in 1994–1999 can also receive free HPV vaccinations on site during Vårruset in Växjö.

name: Startmilen (Örebro)

price_tiers.distance: 10 km Tävling (Junior, Senior, Veteran M/K35-60) Motion

description: Startmilen is a recreational race in Örebro that is suitable for all runners and marks the start of the outdoor season for many. The race offers a 1 km distance for children, 5 km for youths and veterans, and 10 km for competitive categories. The 10 km race is also the district championship for Southern Svealand. The start and finish are at Tybblelundshallen by Örebro University, and the course runs along streets in the Almby district. All participants receive a medal, and prizes are awarded in various categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish outside Tybblelundshallen by Örebro University
The course runs along streets in the Almby district
The 10 km race is the district championship (DM) for Southern Svealand and is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation
additional: Race bibs are distributed at Tybblelundshallen from approximately 10:30 on race day. Timing uses a transponder, which is loaned out when race bibs are collected and must be returned after crossing the finish line. A fee of SEK 800 is charged for a lost transponder. All categories except KnatteStarten are timed. Late registration is available at Tybblelundshallen until 60 minutes before the start, subject to availability and at a higher fee. All runners who complete the race receive a medal. The 5 km prize ceremony is at 13:40 and the 10 km prize ceremony is at 15:30.

name: Bėgimas, skirtas Pasaulinei sveikatos dienai paminėti
organizer: Lietuvos sporto draugija „Žalgiris“ ir Kėdainių sporto centras
description: Kėdainiai Sports Centre invites everyone to take part in a run celebrating World Health Day. This is a community-focused, active event aimed at promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity, and strengthening the physical and mental health of the community. It is a great opportunity for families, children, young people, and older adults to come together and spend time actively in Kėdainiai. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Programme, which supports the organization of mass physical activity events.
course_highlights: Physical activity sessions
Health screenings
Community engagement
additional: The event is open to all age groups—families, children, young people, and older residents. It is organized by the Lithuanian Sports Society „Žalgiris“ and Kėdainiai Sports Centre. The event is part of the National Physical Activity Programme, which promotes mass participation in physical activity. It includes a range of physical activity sessions, screenings, sports competitions, and lectures, and will take place in the city of Kėdainiai, with the central city stadium as the main venue.

name: Suwałki Miss Run & Suwalski Bieg z Wąsem
Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Stockholm, with races for all ages. These include a Mini Race for the youngest participants, Lilla Skärholmsloppet for children in preschool class through grade 6, a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The event is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that supports young people in disadvantaged suburbs through personal development using running. The day features music and entertainment, with DJs along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, encouraging running experience that promotes physical activity and health equity.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up
Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approximately 1.6 km, for children in preschool class through grade 6
500-metre Mini Race for children aged 0–6, with the option to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Start times: Mini Race at 10:30; Lilla Skärholmsloppet from 11:30 in different age-group waves; 1.6 km Fun Run at 12:25; 5 km race at 13:00. All participants receive a medal and refreshments at the finish. Registration is free and open until 14 May at 17:00. Late registration may be available at bib collection and on race day, subject to availability. Music and DJs along the course provide extra encouragement. The event takes place at Puckelbollplanen in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a medal after finishing.

name: TEC 200 miles
description: TEC 200 miles is a challenging ultrarunning race held in Tyresö, starting and completing laps at Alby Friluftsgård. The course is an 11.5 km loop featuring hilly terrain, technical trails and beautiful views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve and Tyresö-Flaten. The race is part of Tyresö Extreme Challenge, which offers several distances, including Backyard Ultra, MiniUltra 46 km, 50 miles and 100 miles. It combines tough challenges with a strong sense of community and positive energy among runners and race volunteers.
course_highlights: 11.5 km loop course starting and finishing at Alby Friluftsgård
Hilly gravel roads and technical trails with roots and rocks
Fantastic views of Lake Albysjön, Tyresta Nature Reserve and Tyresö-Flaten
additional: The start and lap turnaround are at Alby Friluftsgård in Tyresö. The course is marked with orange reflective markers spaced 20–70 metres apart. Runners pass a tent with a buffet and race volunteers at the lap turnaround, but are advised not to stop for too long. The race takes place over the whole weekend, with several distances and start times. The 200-mile race starts at 10:00 on race day. The race takes place in mid-April and may require endurance in difficult weather conditions, including icy or cold conditions early in the season.

name: Vantaan Maantiejuoksucup 5/5
description: The Vantaa Road Running Cup is Finland’s largest and fastest winter running series, consisting of five events in Hakunila and Tikkurila, Vantaa. The races offer accessible road-running competitions, with the option to enter using a series pass or by paying for a single race. The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School, which also serves as the event centre. At the final event, the top runners in each category are awarded prizes based on points, and runners are also encouraged with bonuses for course records. The event is open to runners of all levels and also includes a running school with coaching.
course_highlights: The route runs around Sotunki Upper Secondary School in Vantaa
Sotunki Upper Secondary School serves as the event centre, with changing rooms and showers
Sports drinks are available at the finish area, along with a café
additional: A series pass lets you take part in all five events without registering separately. Race numbers are collected from the race office and returned after each race. Prizes are awarded based on points after the final event, and runners must take part in at least two events to qualify for overall prizes. The running school offers coaching and training sessions, and members can participate in the road-running cup for free by claiming a pass in advance. The event is held in Tikkurila, Vantaa, and includes several races, such as the 5K and 10K. These popular local events offer accessible road-running races.

name: Tjust Trail Run
location: Västervik, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organised by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging, sweaty competition on winding trails, across beautiful rocky outcrops and through the scenic countryside of Småland. Participants get to experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running on technical, hilly trails. Welcome to an enjoyable running experience in beautiful natural surroundings, with a great atmosphere and dedicated race staff.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Småland forest
Technical sections with elevation and rocky terrain
A passage through a forest tunnel and muddy sections
additional: You can change your distance by email until 10 April. Cut-off time for the longest distance (The Long Run), with a lap split at 11:45. Your race bib must be clearly visible. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. If you withdraw, contact race staff or call the phone number provided when collecting your race bib. Transport from aid stations can be arranged if needed.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarunning event held on a 6,706-metre loop, with the start at 10:00. The race follows the original format: each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the next start is on the hour. The winner is the person who completes one more lap than the others. The 6,706-metre distance was chosen because 24 laps equal 100 miles, a dream distance for many ultrarunners, but everyone is welcome regardless of ambition.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre loop
Starts on the hour; the race continues until one runner remains
24 laps equal 100 miles (161 km)
additional: The original Backyard Ultra format: each lap must be completed within one hour, with the next start on the hour. The loop is 6,706 m on the Stensö exercise trail (a gravel-surfaced trail). 24 laps make 100 miles. Organizer: Högby IF. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02.

name: Varvetmilen Sollentuna
location: Strandvägen to Sollentunavallen, Sollentuna, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Varvetmilen Sollentuna is a 10 km race that challenges you to run your best 10K in Sollentuna. The course runs through the town, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen, with a water station at 5 km. The final section is beautifully situated along the water on Nils Göranssons promenad before the finish at Sollentunavallen. Your Varvetmilen result counts toward seeding for Göteborgsvarvet 2026, giving you the opportunity to secure a better starting group there.
course_highlights: The course runs through Sollentuna, south along Sköldvägen and Sollentunavägen
Water station at 5 km
The final section runs along the water on Nils Göranssons promenad
additional: The start and finish area is at Sollentunavallen and Strandvägen, near the water. Bib collection and bag drop are available at the venue on race day. Minivarvet for children aged 0–6 takes place at the same time and covers 210 metres; registration is on-site (80 SEK via Swish). The race is an important seeding race for Göteborgsvarvet and offers facilities including bib collection and bag drop.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt's Marathon in Hultsfred is a personal and welcoming marathon and half marathon held to celebrate Kurt Gustavsson's 80th birthday and his 300th marathon. The course is a five-lap park path around Lake Hulingen, with approximately 20% asphalt, and is officially measured and sanctioned. The race offers two refreshment stations with water, sports drink, cola, and energy supplements. After the race, participants are invited to a get-together with food and good company near the start and finish at Knektavallen.
course_highlights: Five-lap course around Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred
20% of the course is asphalt; the rest is park path
Two refreshment stations with sports drink, cola, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the entrance to Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Race numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take more than 5 hours should start at 09:00. After the race, a get-together with food and good company is offered at approximately 14:30, about 1 km from the start. The race is part of a festive event celebrating Kurt Gustavsson and is a unique opportunity for runners to take part in a private but officially sanctioned competition.

name: Bėgimas „Tropem Wilczym 2026“
organizer: Lenkijos Respublikos ambasada Vilniuje, Lietuvos lenkų jaunimas, asociacija „Sporto renginiai“
description: The international “Tropem Wilczym 2026” run will take place in Vingis Park, Vilnius, and is dedicated to honoring members of the anti-Nazi, anti-communist, and anti-Soviet underground. The event promotes running and athletics in Lithuania, encourages a healthy lifestyle, and aims to bring together runners of all ages. Participants can choose from several distances, and the event is organized with a strong focus on safety and professionalism. It is a great opportunity for both professionals and amateurs to take part in a meaningful sporting event.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Vingis Park near the band shell
Distances: the symbolic 1963 m run, 5.2 km, 10.5 km, and a half marathon
The course will be closed and traffic restrictions introduced to ensure safety
additional: On race day, the timing system will operate until 13:30; after that, times will not be recorded. The number of participants is limited to 1,200. It is possible to switch to a shorter distance for a €2 fee. Participants must bring an ID document to collect their race bib. The event combines sport and history, offers several distances, including the symbolic 1,963-metre course, and emphasizes the importance of community. Participant age groups apply, and the use of vehicles or personal escorts is prohibited.

name: Vårruset (Stockholm)
description: Vårruset in Stockholm is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances in Norra Djurgården. The event celebrates the joy of movement and togetherness, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition level. Participants can register individually or as part of a team; registered teams receive a picnic after the finish. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Certified 5 km course in Norra Djurgården
Start and finish at Frescatiängen, near Stockholm University
The course follows gravel paths and forest trails in a scenic setting
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register before 17 April; otherwise, they must be collected at the event. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available for a fee. The recommended minimum age is 13 for the 5 km and 11 for the 2.5 km; younger participants may take part when accompanied by an adult. You can opt out of timing when registering. The event area is easiest to reach on foot, by bike or by public transport. Parking is limited and not recommended. The event is part of Sweden’s largest women’s fitness tour and focuses on community and health.

name: Blodomloppet
location: Västra Marks IP, Karlskrona, Blekinge, Sweden
organizer: Blodcentralerna i Blekinge och KA 2 IF

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 1750 kr tom 29 april

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 2000 kr tom 13 maj

description: Blodomloppet in Karlskrona is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run the 5 km or 10 km distances, take part in the 800-metre children’s race, or enter a special 5 km walking class. The event is open to both individual participants and teams, and concludes with a shared picnic for all participants. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, and walkers have a separate route to make it possible for everyone to finish together. Blodomloppet is one of Sweden’s largest public health initiatives and attracts many participants every year.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km running courses
Separate 5 km route for walkers
800-metre children’s race
additional: The event offers individual and team registration (maximum 5 people per team). Team members can take part in different distances. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA members (SEK 40 per person). Large registrations can be handled using an Excel template and a customer page in the registration system. Walkers set off first on a separate route to make it possible to share a picnic after the race. Facilities include changing rooms, toilets, water stations and medical care, and participants can travel to and from the event free of charge. The race is officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association. Participants can run at the venue or take part remotely between 17 May and 7 September 2027. Race packs include a T-shirt, medal and bib. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA members.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race starting, with exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four each run a fast-paced four-kilometre leg. The event offers a wonderful team atmosphere, with men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course stays close to the event centre, with upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish. It’s an evening filled with exercise, community and joy, where children and young people can take part for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on a fast-paced course close to the event centre
Upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish
additional: Leg massages are offered by Helhetshälsan both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes go to the first team in each category, and great prizes are drawn among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides participants with energy-packed products after the finish. The race takes place in Folkparken, with on-site late registration available; participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-packed products after the race.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances through central Västerås, with the start and finish at Lögastrand. The event celebrates the joy of being active and a sense of community, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition. Participants can register individually or as a team; registered teams receive a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive setting for exercise and socialising.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Livli Shopping Centre Erikslund in the days before the race. The event area has supervised bag drop, a water station and toilets. Picnics can be collected using the team leader’s race bib. Recommended ages are 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Training meetups are organised in several locations ahead of the race. Participants receive a race bib, a finish-line bag and a medal; teams consist of 5 people. The event is open to runners, joggers and walkers. Registration is online. The event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: Blodcentralen i Östergötland och IK Akele samt Blodtappen i Östergötland
description: Blodomloppet in Linköping is one of Sweden’s largest fun runs, highlighting the vital need for blood donation. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 or 10 kilometres, either individually or as part of a team. The blood donation bus will be at the event for anyone who would like to donate blood. The race has strong local roots, with ambassadors and local partnerships. It is a social, healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic, and any surplus supports youth activities.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in Linköping
Opportunity to register as a blood donor on site via the blood donation bus
The race is being held for the twenty-second time, with a local ambassador
additional: Youth teams (five members born in 2009 or later) pay half the entry fee when registered by 30 April. Teams can be brought up to five participants at no extra cost by 30 April. Participants who register by 14 May receive six hours of free public transport within Östergötland on race day via an SMS ticket. Late registration is available when race numbers are distributed in the days before the event. Payment can be made by Swish, card or e-invoice for businesses. The event includes different distances for adults and children, with the option to walk or run, as well as blood donation on site. It is a large community celebration featuring music and social activities.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging 5 km trail race with 300 metres of elevation gain in beautiful, technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course features lovely trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The race starts at the old football field and includes steep hills, singletrack and scenic views over Lake Ågelsjön. Welcome to this somewhat classic race, which offers a serious challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 metres of elevation gain in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep hills
Beautiful views over Lake Ågelsjön and a passage past the hermit’s Jakobs Cave
additional: The race starts at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, along with raffle prizes. A ball field is located 200 metres from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are available as add-ons. The course’s technical sections include “Koklämman,” with a rope to help runners climb, and the race passes a cosy barbecue area beneath a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk; the course description includes hills and trail sections.

name: ÜLEMISTE Grit 2027
organizer: Eesti Ööjooks - Night Run Estonia ja Liikumisharrastuse kompetentsikeskus

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Virtuaalne osalemine: 24€ (sisaldab medalit, tulemuse haldamise tasu ja saatmiskulu)

description: Ülemiste Grit is an immersive endurance running event held inside Ülemiste Centre in Tallinn. Participants can choose a 1-, 2- or 3-hour challenge, running a 552-metre loop. The event is not a race, but an opportunity to enjoy moving and challenge yourself: you can run, walk or power-walk. There is an aid station on the course offering water, juice and solid food, and a medal and gift bag await at the finish. The event has a limited number of participants and offers a unique indoor running experience.
course_highlights: The course runs on the second floor of Ülemiste Centre; each loop is 552 m long.
The indoor course has tiled floors and extensive glass surfaces, so take care.
The aid station offers water, juice, Coca-Cola and solid food (banana, pickles, bread, meat product, chocolate and orange).
additional: Race pack collection takes place from 19:00 to 21:30 on the third floor of the Ülemiste Centre parking garage. Bag storage at the event centre costs €2. Medals and gift bags are handed out at the event centre after finishing. After finishing, participants are asked to stay in the finish area briefly for a group photo. Participants in the 2-hour distance are asked to enter the start area via the first floor (take the escalator near Rimi). The event is sold out; on-site registration is not available. The virtual run option ends on 22.04.2027. Participants can leave their own drinks bottles along the course, labelled with their names. The event is non-competitive and emphasises cooperation and safety. Participants receive gift bags; the course is designed to be an experience, not for chasing records.

name: Skälbyloppet
location: Skälby loge, Kalmar kommun, Kalmar län, Sweden
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly recreational race in Kalmar, organised by Högby IF on 25 April 2026. The event offers two main distances, 4 km and 8 km (1 and 2 laps over the bridge, respectively), as well as youth events from 600 m to approximately 1.9 km. The course runs through the Skälby surroundings on gravel and park paths, with a short stretch of asphalt. Water is available at the lap point and at the finish. All finishers receive a medal, and registration follows the schedule provided by the organiser.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km courses (1 and 2 laps over the bridge, respectively)
Youth distances from 600 m to 1.9 km
Easy-to-run gravel and woodland paths with a short stretch of asphalt
additional: Water is available at the lap point on the longer course and at the finish. Race numbers can be collected at Skälby loge; start times follow the schedule, and late registration is available as stated by the organiser. The 4 km and 8 km courses follow the usual route (1 and 2 laps over the bridge, respectively). On-site attendance is required for certain officials’ registrations under RF standards. Race numbers can be collected at Skälby loge on Friday 24 April from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day from 08:30; late registration is accepted at race-number collection up to 1 hour before the start. Water is available at the lap point on the longer course and at the finish; all finishers receive a medal.

name: adidas Premiärhalvan
description: Adidas Premiärhalvan is a half marathon of 21.1 km held in Stockholm on 25 April 2026. The race starts at 11:00 and has a time limit of three hours, with the start and finish area at Biskopsudden. The course loops around Södra Djurgården and passes scenic areas close to central Stockholm. The race is organised by Marathongruppen and is seen as good preparation for adidas Stockholm Marathon, while welcoming everyone who wants to experience the spring scenery in a beautiful half marathon close to the city. Registration is available at different price tiers (495–745 kr), and bib and start information is shared in advance. Refreshment stations and medical staff are available along the course.
course_highlights: The course loops around Södra Djurgården, starting and finishing at Biskopsudden
Beautiful spring scenery and scenic views close to central Stockholm
A mix of surfaces along the course: asphalt, gravel and paving stones
additional: The race is preparation for adidas Stockholm Marathon and includes bib distribution in advance, along with start information. Refreshment stations and medical staff are available along the course. The time limit is 3 hours, and the minimum age is 17. The deadline for reporting results for seeding is 31 March. The course is a one-lap, 21.1 km loop on Södra Djurgården (asphalt/gravel/paving stones), and Enervit sports drink is available along the course.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
description: Munkastigen Trailrun is organized by Laxå OK and takes place on Saturday, 25 April 2026, starting in Olshammar. The race page has maps, an elevation profile and a GPX file that can be downloaded to help you plan your run. The race invitation and registration link are published under the current year in the menu on the club’s website. You are welcome to take part and consult the course information before the race.
course_highlights: Start in Olshammar
Maps (Map part 1 and Map part 2) and elevation profile available
GPX file available to download (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx, thanks to Jonas Brännmyr)
additional: The race invitation and registration link are published under the current year in the menu on the website. Course information includes Map part 1 and part 2, as well as an elevation profile. The GPX file (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx) is available to download. The race runs from Olshammar on the shore of Lake Vättern to Laxå in Tiveden. Teams consist of 2–5 runners, with the changeover at any location along the course. An SI card is recommended or can be rented. Start and finish: start at 11:00 in Olshammar, finish at the Laxå OK clubhouse.

name: Vårmilen (Lidingöloppet Vårmilen)

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2

tiers.description: Vårmilen 5 km 325 kr till och med 2026-04-24

description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a spring 5 km and 10 km race starting and finishing at Lidingövallen. The course is described as one of Stockholm’s most beautiful 10 km routes and runs along winding forest roads, through meadows and beside the archipelago coast. It is mostly on soft trails and is hilly in places. The race counts towards seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet and is suitable both for runners who want to check their fitness and for those hoping to secure a better starting group. Before and after the races, coffee and light meals are available to buy at the café at Lidingövallen.
course_highlights: Winding forest roads past meadows and along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft trails; hilly (10 km: 127 m elevation gain, 5 km: 52 m)
Water station at 5 km and at the finish; the course is marked with red-and-white tape and kilometre flags
additional: Race-number pickup is available from 09:30 on race day until 30 minutes before the start. Late registration is available at Lidingövallen from 09:30 and up to 60 minutes before the start. Name and category changes can be made via Mina sidor for a fee (details and fees are available on the website) or in person for a higher fee. Free bag storage is available; valuables storage costs 20 SEK (Swish 1235557608). Parking near Lidingövallen is limited (40 SEK via Swish 1234575775); the organiser recommends public transport (metro to Ropsten + bus 204/211/212). Changing facilities, showers and a sauna are available indoors at Lidingövallen. Course surface: asphalt for the first 2.5 km, then gravel and trails; the final 350 m is on the running track. Distances: 5 km and 10 km; Knattarnas Vårmil for younger children; water station at 5 km and water at the finish; seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet.

name: VXO Ultrafest
location: Trummens södra strand, Växjö, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: VXO Ultrafest is an ultrarunning and race-walking festival held in Växjö on the southern shore of Lake Trummen on 25–26 April 2026. The event includes the Swedish Championships in 24-hour running and 100 km ultrarunning, as well as the Swedish Championships in race walking, with a marathon for men and a half marathon for women. The courses are flat and consist mainly of asphalt, with some gravel sections, providing good conditions for fast and enjoyable races. Växjö Running Club welcomes both returning participants and new runners and race walkers to this annual festive weekend.
course_highlights: Flat loop course for VXO24h, approximately 820 metres, mostly asphalt with some gravel sections
The course for VXO100k and the Swedish Race Walking Championships (42 km and 21 km) runs around Lake Trummen, approximately 3.2 km per lap
The event area is on open grassy grounds on the southern shore of Lake Trummen, with space for tents and the lap area
additional: Pre-race dinner on Friday 24/4. The lap area is at the event venue, where there is space for the organiser’s tents and participants’ own tents. The event includes ultramarathon and race-walking events, and takes place on a flat course of asphalt and gravel, providing good conditions for records and strong performances.

name: Vårmilen
organizer: IFK Lidingö Friidrott / Lidingöloppet Marknads AB
description: Lidingöloppet Vårmilen is a popular running challenge featuring one of Stockholm’s most beautiful 10 km courses. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km on winding forest roads, through meadows and along the archipelago coast. The course is mostly soft and hilly, making the race a gentle, scenic start to the running season. The race also counts towards seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet, offering the chance to start in a better starting group at the classic autumn trail race. There are water and sports drink stations, as well as entertainment along the course.
course_highlights: Winding forest roads and meadows
Running along the archipelago coast
Mostly soft, hilly trails
additional: Start and finish at Lidingövallen. Water and sports drink station at 5 km and at the finish. Group warm-up before the start. Free bag drop; valuables drop-off costs 20 kr. Changing rooms with showers and a sauna are available. The course is marked with white ribbons and spray arrows, with marshals at difficult points. Travelling by public transport or bicycle is recommended as parking is limited. Distance and name changes can be made for a fee before and on race day. Trail course, hilly, start and finish at Lidingövallen, accessible by public transport and car, limited parking

name: Tradicinis bėgimas Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė
location: Baltoji Vokė, Rūdiškių seniūnija, Vilniaus rajonas, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The traditional international Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė run is an annual spring sports celebration held in Baltoji Vokė. This traditional race brings together running enthusiasts from Lithuania and abroad. The event has a long history and a friendly atmosphere that encourages an active lifestyle and community spirit.
course_highlights: Traditional Baltoji Vokė - Rūdininkai - Baltoji Vokė route
Part of the spring sports celebration
Held annually since at least 2018
additional: The event takes place during the spring sports celebration. Registration is managed by the Lithuanian Running Cup. In previous years, the start time was usually 11:00. Several hundred athletes take part; the event includes awards, sponsor support, and safety arrangements.

name: PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
Sportland Kõrvemaa Kevadjooks 2027
location: Sportland Kõrvemaa Matka- ja Suusakeskus, Kõrvemaa, Estonia
description: Sportland Kõrvemaa Spring Run is a beautiful spring running event held amid the ancient natural landscapes of the Kõrvemaa Nature Reserve. The event centre is conveniently located near Tallinn at the Sportland Kõrvemaa Hiking and Ski Centre. The varied routes include a 16 km main distance, a 6 km run and a youth run. Free children’s runs, activities for the whole family and childcare are also available. After the run, participants can enjoy hot soup, a sauna and hot tubs, as well as an exciting treasure hunt at Anija Manor.
course_highlights: The entire route runs through a nature reserve
A range of distances: 16 km, 6 km and a youth run
Event centre conveniently located near Tallinn
additional: Free bus transport is provided for participants between Aegviidu railway station and the event centre, in both directions. The event centre has childcare, a bag drop, a Stebby wellbeing area with Fysiotikker, and a Sportland pop-up shop where you can top up on running gear. For children, Aegviidu RMK offers nature-themed activities, a low ropes course, a mini-pancake café, and horse and pony rides (bring cash). A sauna and hot tubs will be open after the run. Participants can enter a draw to win a stylish Trek city bike at the Spring Run awards ceremony at 14:00. Group discounts: 10% off when registering at least 5 participants, and 20% off when registering at least 10 participants. A 50% discount is available for seniors (60+) and young people (up to 17) when registering in advance; the minimum final price is €15. The event takes place on 25 April 2027, offering a choice of distances and the chance to enjoy outdoor exercise and time with family.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Bålsta City Race, held on 26 April 2026 at Gröna Dalens IP in Bålsta. The race is known for its fast, spectator-friendly course, where many runners have set personal bests. Organised by Bålsta IK, it has grown every year since it began in 2019. The race offers the Sparbanksloppet 5 km (one lap) and 10 km (two laps), with the finish inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens. The organisers highlight speed, enjoyment and a welcoming event atmosphere for both elite and recreational runners.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (for a total of 5 km or 10 km)
Approximately 99% asphalt; the finish is inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens IP
Known as a fast course where many runners have set personal records, with several course records documented
additional: Race bibs can be collected inside Gröna Dalens IP from 08:00. Late registration may be available online, subject to space, until 1 hour before each start on race day. The start and finish are at Gröna Dalens sports ground (Badhusvägen); Bålsta station, served by commuter train line 43, is approximately an 850 m walk from the venue. Several parking options are available 100–900 metres away; Badhusvägen will be closed on race day. There is a bag drop (please attach the lower part of your race bib to your bag), limited changing and shower facilities, and toilets near the venue. Umara sports drink and water are available at the 5 km lap point. A 5 km team competition (Sparbanksloppet) is being introduced; the course is described as fast and personal-best-friendly.

name: Landsjön runt
price_range: 12,5 km: 250-350 kr; 5,5 km: 150-250 kr; Vista FUN RUN: gratis eller 100 kr efter sista anmälningsdatum

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Herr/Dam 13-99 år 12,5 km 250 kr 350 kr efter 19/4

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Herr/Dam 7-99 år 5,5 km 150 kr 250 kr efter 19/4

price_tiers.distance: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km

tiers.description: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km 7-12 år GRATIS. 100 kr efter 19/4

description: Landsjön Runt is a road race in a scenic setting by Lake Landsjön in Kaxholmen, outside Huskvarna. We offer a family day with races for all ages: 12.5 km and 5.5 km for adults and young people, as well as several children’s races, including the Vista FUN RUN. The race goes around the lake, starting and finishing at Vistavallen, with musicians and water stations along the course adding to the atmosphere. The event welcomes both individual entries and team competitions for teams of four.
course_highlights: A road race in scenic surroundings around Lake Landsjön, starting and finishing at Vistavallen
12.5 km and 5.5 km routes by the lake; the course is run clockwise, so the climbs come early
Music along the course and water stations for participants
additional: Parking is available at Vistavallen (taking public transport or parking at Hunnerydsbadet is recommended). Teams consist of four people, all running the same distance; their combined time is recorded, and teams receive a bag from Rudenstams farm shop. A course record in the 12.5 km race earns SEK 5,000 for the runner’s club. Payment is made via Swish to 123 429 98 22, and no automatic confirmation is sent—you are registered if you have received a six-digit number and paid. IK Vista members participate for free if they register by 20/4 (the website also mentions 19/4 in one line). Registration closes on 25/4 at 17:00, but race-day registration may be available, subject to space, at least one hour before the race. Registration closes on 25 April at 17:00. Payment is made via Swish. IK Vista members participate for free if they register by 20 April; enter IK Vista as your club and do not pay. The start list is published one week before the race. The race includes water stations and music along the course; team registration is available, with a shared finish and result.

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet is Huddinge AIS Athletics’ running festival at Källbrinks IP, open to all levels, with both shorter fun runs and technical trail options. The event offers a children’s race, 3 km and 5 km fun runs, and 7 km and 17 km trail races, welcoming both recreational runners and more experienced trail runners. The course runs mostly along narrow forest trails and includes sections of technical terrain with rocks, roots and steep hills, as well as several scenic stretches. Prizes are awarded to the fastest woman and man in several races, and everyone who finishes receives a medal.
course_highlights: Runs mostly along narrow forest trails, with some very technical sections featuring rocks, roots and steep hills
Several scenic stretches along the course
The 17 km course follows Gömmaren’s black-and-white “SKATAN” trail
additional: Date and location: 26 April at Källbrinks IP (Gamla Stockholmsvägen 91, Huddinge). Start times: Children’s 700 m race 11:00; Trail 17 km 11:10; Fun runs 3 km and 5 km 12:00; Trail 7 km 12:00. Prizes: Trophies for the first woman and man to finish in the 3 km, 5 km, Trail 7 km and Trail 17 km races; a medal for everyone who finishes. A large prize pool from ICA Kvantum Kungens Kurva, with race bibs serving as raffle tickets; prize-giving at approximately 13:00; novelty prizes and medals for the children’s race immediately after finishing. Organizer: Huddinge AIS (contact: pelle@huddingeais.se, phone 0706758799). Register by 19 April 2026; team discount for at least 5 participants; race bibs can be collected on race day; results are available at kvantumloppet.se

name: Orion Trail
location: Ådalen, Jämjö, Karlskrona kommun, Blekinge län, Sverige
description: Orion Trail takes place in Ådalen in Jämjö, outside Karlskrona in Blekinge. The race follows scenic trails along the river and passes a waterfall and a sea of wood anemones. It can be run or walked. The organiser, OK Orion, welcomes participants to a scenic trail experience on 26 April 2026. The event features an easy to moderately challenging course in beautiful surroundings near Karlskrona.
course_highlights: Trails along Ådalen and the river, with varied surfaces
A waterfall along the course
Wood anemones in a springtime natural setting
additional: Booking is via the MittLopp link. Trail running on paths in Ådalen; Facebook event: https://fb.me/e/1TyHBrexxh

name: STHLM Trail Run
description: STHLM Trail Run is a trail race in Norra Djurgården in Stockholm, where you can choose between 5 km and 10 km. The course offers beautiful forest terrain and technical sections along Fisksjöäng, with the start area at Norra Djurgårdsstaden. The race is organised by Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK and offers conventional timing, a medal and finish-line services. Start times are 11:00 for 5 km and 12:00 for 10 km; the minimum ages are 13 (11 when accompanied by a guardian) for 5 km and 15 (13 when accompanied by a guardian) for 10 km.
course_highlights: Beautiful forest course through Norra Djurgården with natural trail challenges
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Easy access by public transport (reachable from Ropsten; close to Stureplan by bike)
additional: Distances: 5 km (start 11:00, minimum age 13, 11 when accompanied by a guardian) and 10 km (start 12:00, minimum age 15, 13 when accompanied by a guardian). Event area: Fisksjöäng, Norra Djurgårdsstaden. Medal, finish-line services, race bib with timing and water along the course. Registration is personal and can be completed online up to 1 hour before the first start. Payment options: Swish, Visa/MasterCard, Klarna invoice. Start times: 5 km 11:00 (minimum age 13, 11 when accompanied by a guardian) and 10 km 12:00 (minimum age 15, 13 when accompanied by a guardian). Included: medal, finish-line services, race bib with timing and water along the course; registration is open until 1 hour before the first start.

name: Kauno Akropolio maratonas 2026
description: The Kauno Akropolis Marathon is an annual international running event in Kaunas, attracting thousands of participants. The event is for everyone, regardless of age or fitness level, and aims to promote social and physical activity and healthy-lifestyle traditions in Lithuania. The marathon and half-marathon courses are certified by World Athletics (WA) and the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS). It is a sporting celebration for both professionals and recreational runners, held in a safe environment that meets high standards.
course_highlights: The marathon and half-marathon courses are certified by WA and AIMS
The course is measured according to international standards
The event is certified with a 5-star quality label
additional: The event is certified with a 5-star quality label, ensuring the highest standards of safety and service. The marathon courses meet international standards. The event is for both professionals and recreational runners and takes place in Kaunas. It is organized by the public institution "Kauno maratono klubas". The event offers a virtual running option, group registration, various distances, and certified courses.

name: Palangos pusės maratono bėgimas „PRALENK ŽIRGĄ“
description: The Palanga Half Marathon “OUTRUN THE HORSE” is a high-quality half-marathon event held in celebration of St. George’s Day. The event aims to establish Palanga as a European City of Sport and encourage physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents and visitors. The race takes place in the resorts of Palanga and Šventoji, expanding the range of mass sporting events and encouraging local community participation in sports.
course_highlights: Start in Šventoji and finish in Palanga
The course is marked and adapted for runners
Promotes a healthy lifestyle and popularizes sports
additional: Traffic restrictions and public relations campaigns are planned to ensure the event runs smoothly.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on 1 May 2026—a running festival for the whole family, with distances ranging from children’s races to a half marathon. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and Lilla Växjöloppet for younger participants. The start and finish are in Strandbjörket, with the start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen. The course combines forest trails through scenic Bokhultet with paved sections around Växjösjön. The half marathon is run over two laps on largely the same course, offering variety and spectator-friendly finishes.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course passing through Bokhultet (mostly deciduous forest), becoming a forest trail after the first kilometre
The final approximately 3.5 km are paved and run around Växjösjön, with the finish straight at Lagunvallen
additional: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and several children’s race distances in Lilla Växjöloppet (children’s races are not individually timed). The 21.1 km race is run over two laps (the first lap is just over 11 km, the second is 10 km). Water stations: the 10 km course has four stations (after 1 km, 3 km, 5.5 km and 6.5 km); on the 21.1 km course, runners can take water eight times (including at 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5 and 16.5 km). Lilla Växjöloppet: participants in some children’s races receive a race number, medal and fruit; Tidningslöpet provides a T-shirt and diploma. You can use your wellness allowance to pay the entry fee (register via mittlopp.se and submit the receipt to your employer for reimbursement through the wellness allowance). A team competition is available; start lists and participant information are on the official website. Distances are 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and Lilla Växjöloppet; water stations are located along the course (4 on the 10 km course; up to 8 water stops on the 21.1 km course); the Bokhultet station closes at 13:40 and the tunnel/Växjösjön station closes at 14:00; the finish closes at 14:30.

name: SwampMan Backyard ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė
description: SwampMan Backyard Ultra 6 by Trailo Kalvė is a unique endurance race in Alytus, near Lake Dailidė. The event invites runners to test their limits on a Backyard Ultra course, a format that makes it easier to reach the 100-mile distance. There will be only one winner, and the challenge is demanding—things seem easy only up to a certain point. It is a great opportunity to experience the true spirit of endurance running and earn DNF status with honour.
course_highlights: Trail run around Lake Dailidė
Backyard Ultra endurance format, designed for reaching 100 miles
Race venue in Alytus, on the slopes of Vidzgiris
additional: The race regulations are available in PDF format. The event takes place in Alytus, near Lake Dailidė. More than 120 participants. The race follows the Backyard Ultra format, in which the winner is the last runner remaining. The event venue is Lake Dailidė in Alytus; the course is approximately 6.7 km long, with wooded and paved sections. Participants may bring their own tent. Car and camper parking is available outside the start area. Food and drinks are available during the event.

name: 63-asis tradicinis bėgimas „Anykščiai - Puntuko akmuo - Anykščiai“
description: The 63rd traditional “Anykščiai - Puntukas Stone - Anykščiai” race invites participants to spend May 7 actively amid the beautiful landscapes of the Anykščiai region. The race distances and difficulty levels are suited to participants of different ages and fitness levels, from a fun run for children to an 11 km challenge for endurance runners. The event is the oldest in Lithuania and is renowned for its tradition and friendly atmosphere, attracting sports enthusiasts from across the country. Participants will receive commemorative medals, while the fastest runners in the 11 km distance will win cash prizes.
course_highlights: A scenic route through the Anykščiai landscape, winding through the Anykščiai Forest celebrated in the poetry of Antanas Baranauskas
Distances for all abilities: from 300 m for children to 11 km for endurance runners
Start near the Angels Museum in Anykščiai
additional: Starts by age group: 10:30 — children’s fun run “Puntukėlis”; 11:30 — 3 km distance; 11:50 — race opening ceremony; 12:00 — 6 km and 11 km distances. Registration is open only until April 28 at 12:00; registration will not be available on race day. Participants who finish will receive commemorative medals. The fastest runners in the 11 km distance will receive cash prizes. Participants are offered advance registration, the opportunity to recover after the race in a swimming pool and sauna complex, prizes and discounts, and various age groups.

name: Klaipėdos EKOMaratonas
description: Klaipėda EKOMarathon is a traditional running event held on the forest trails of Giruliai in Klaipėda. Both amateur and professional runners can take part, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity. Distances range from 2 km for schoolchildren to 42.2 km for Ekomarathon participants, who run 10 laps of 4.2 km each. The event is organized by the Klaipėda city running club “Maratonas” and supported by Klaipėda City Municipality.
course_highlights: Ekomarathon course: 10 laps of 4.2 km on the forest trails of Giruliai
Schoolchildren’s course: 2 km (1 km out, 1 km back)
Start in Giruliai Forest, at the beginning of the bike path beyond the Summer Stage
additional: On race day, the timing system operates until 15:00. The entry fee is paid on site when collecting the race number. The first 300 participants receive commemorative medals; all participants receive certificates. Participants must bring an identity document to collect their race number. Participants agree that event organizers may use photographs and video footage taken during the event for marketing purposes. 4.2 km and 42.2 km distances, 2 km schoolchildren’s race, start in Giruliai Forest, online registration until April 30.

X Półmaraton Doliną Rospudy
location: Filipów, Suwałki County, Podlaskie Voivodeship, Poland

name: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra 2026
description: WINTER BAY Backyard Ultra is a welcoming Backyard Ultra race in Trekantsparken, Liljeholmen, Stockholm, organized by Run Raisers with fundraising for #Run4Diabetes. The race takes place on a 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken, on mixed terrain, with a new start every hour on the hour; participants must complete the loop within 1 hour to start the next one. The event offers an aid station, a medal, a goodie bag, and organizer support throughout the race. The start is at 14:00 on May 1, 2026.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop around Trekanten and Vinterviken (start/finish in Trekantsparken, near Liljeholmen metro station)
Mixed terrain: trails with wooden bridges, gravel roads, and paved pedestrian/cycle paths
A steep uphill section at Örnberget and illuminated trails along Vinterviken
additional: Registration opens on August 1. Name changes can be made until 2026-04-17 for a fee of 150 SEK (by emailing info@runraisers.com with the new participant’s details). Race bibs are distributed on Thursday, April 30. Race format: a mass start every hour on the hour; anyone who does not complete the loop within 1 hour is out. The entry fee includes an aid station, race photos, a medal, and a goodie bag; 20% of the fee goes to #Run4Diabetes. The race is a charity event benefiting Run4Diabetes; 20% of the entry fee is donated to Run4Diabetes; the entry includes an aid station, a medal, race photos, a goodie bag, and prizes for the winners.

name: Sevede Trail Run
description: Sevede Trail Run is a welcoming trail race in Mariannelund, organised by Hässleby SOK. The race offers a challenging course that runs mostly along narrow trails through the beautiful Småland landscape—through dark, fairytale-like forests, along lakes and over long slopes with fast descents. There are men’s and women’s categories over 10 km and 26 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 km. Everyone is welcome to register up to race day; the children’s race is free and participants receive a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Mostly narrow trails through the Småland landscape
Through dark, fairytale-like forests and along lakes
Long slopes and fast descents
additional: Registration opens at 08:00 at Slättvallen in Mariannelund. To register, email sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com. Payment is accepted via Swish (123-358 26 99). Late registration is available on race day. The children’s race is approximately 1 km; all children run for free and receive a medal and a banana at the finish. A parent may accompany the child around the course. Distance options: 26 km and 10 km; start window: Saturday 10:00–16:00; contact: sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com; 2025 record number of participants: approximately 45; 2024 women’s course record for 26 km: 2:10:07 by Emelie Braf; children’s race with many participants; results and photos are available.

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a Backyard Ultra on a fast, easy loop course in central Trosa. Each loop is 6.706 km, and the race continues for as long as participants can complete a loop within one hour. The race starts on 2 May 2026 at 10:00. In the Backyard format, anyone who completes a loop within the hour may start again, until only one participant remains. The event is open to the public and family-friendly, with Mini-TUB for children (starting at 12:15) and awards for the top three men and women. The organiser provides sports drink, fruit and sandwiches at the start/finish area, and holds prize draws throughout the race.
course_highlights: 6.706 km loop (main course)
Runs mostly along the Trosaån and is very easy and flat (approximately <10 metres of elevation gain)
Mini-TUB: approximately 700 m course for children (follows the main course for 700 m before branching off)
additional: Start and finish at Västra hamnplan in Trosa; livestream on the Trosa Ultra Backyard Facebook page; Mini-TUB sponsored by Camfil; team competition in which each club’s three best results count (the club with the three best results receives 20% off next year); tent pitches outside the start area; limited motorhome spaces; no caravan spaces; food and energy supplies available (sweets, sports drink and fruit), plus a Selfie Corner after the race; free silicone cup from Umara for all participants in the main race.

name: Vilnius trail run 2026
distance_verbose: 100 km, 100 km, 73 km, 70 km, Maratonas, Pusmaratonas, Pusmaratonas, 15 km, 5 km, 1.8 km
description: Vilnius Trail Run 2027 invites runners to experience a unique variety of courses in Vilnius’s natural surroundings and urban environment. The event offers routes ranging from 15+ km for beginners to a challenging 108 km course around Vilnius. Participants can enjoy varied terrain, including forest trails, mountain roads, and scenic viewpoints offering unforgettable views of the Lithuanian landscape. It is a great opportunity to test your endurance and discover the city’s nature and culture while running.
course_highlights: Unique routes in Vilnius from 15+ km to 108 km
Varied terrain: forest trails and mountain roads
Scenic viewpoints with views of the Lithuanian landscape
additional: The event takes place at Kalnų Park Stadium, T. Kosciuškos g. 5, Vilnius. The number of participants exceeds 1,000. Organizer: VšĮ, address: Balžio g. 21C-5, Vilnius, telephone: +370 610 24484. The event offers courses featuring forest trails, mountain tracks, and scenic viewpoints; participants can choose from various distances and age groups, including an ultramarathon and children’s races.

name: Vilniaus pavasario maratonas
description: The Vilnius Spring Marathon invites runners of all levels to test their strength in the springtime atmosphere of Vilnius’s Vingis Park. The event offers a range of distances, from a 600 m children’s race to the classic 42.195 km marathon, as well as a half marathon and shorter races. It’s a great opportunity to kick off the running season surrounded by nature, moving through the city and its parks while enjoying the renewal of spring. The event is organized with great attention to all participants’ experience and promotes an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Vingis Park amphitheatre
Run through Vilnius city parks and streets
Distances from a 600 m children’s race to the 42.195 km marathon
additional: The event takes place on 2026-05-02, with the start at 10:00 at the Vingis Park amphitheatre. Distances: 42.195 km, 21.098 km, 10.6 km, 5.3 km, and 600 m for children. The regulations are available at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis/nuostatai/. Registration is available at https://www.myrace.lt/maratonadienis. The event offers various distances, including races for children and young people, as well as the option to participate with insurance. Registration is through myrace.lt.

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming running event along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg, open to competitive runners, recreational runners and families. In 2026, the event offers a half marathon (competitive and recreational categories) as well as recreational 10 km and 5 km races, and this year’s edition has DM/VDM status for the half marathon. All races start at 13:00 from their respective start locations, and the finish is at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is promoted as a competition in beautiful Swedish countryside and also offers team registration.
course_highlights: The route follows the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Finish at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
A scenic route through beautiful Swedish countryside along the canal
additional: Transport: Buses are arranged from Borensberg to the respective start locations (the half marathon to Ljungsbro, the 10 km to Sjöbacka, and the 5 km to Brunneby) and must be booked and paid for when registering. No transport is provided after the finish; places may be available on race day, subject to availability. The bus fee listed on the registration pages is 100 kr. Team registration: teams of 5 runners, all in the same category; the price per runner is 20% lower than for individual registration, and team registration is only available online. Race bibs are collected at the respective start locations. Registration is valid only once payment has been received; if payment has not arrived within 10 days, the registration will be cancelled. Further details will be provided later in the race instructions. Start locations: 21 km from Ljungsbro, 10 km from Sjöbacka bridge, and 5 km from Brunneby Musteri; buses to the start from Borensberg; registration via Swish or bankgiro; late registration from 11:30 to 12:30 at an increased price; race bibs are collected at the start location.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is organised by Säters IF FIK and welcomes runners to the event in Säter. The association’s website has the invitation with the course route, race information and start list, as well as results from previous years. Information is published by the club on the SäterMaran page and in its news section. The club encourages participants to read the race information and schedule before the event.
course_highlights: Course route published (see invitation/course route)
Race information and start list available on the event page
Results from 2025 and previous years published
additional: The invitation, course route, race information and start list are published on the SäterMaran page; results from previous years are available there as well. The website mentions an attached document with the invitation/registration information. The association’s official hashtag is #sätersfriidrott. Contact the association office at siffriidrott@telia.com; website contacts are listed on the contact page. The 2024 SäterMaran results include information on the half marathon (DM) and marathon competitions, as well as different age categories, indicating that both distances may be offered as part of the event.
