description: VAIS-loppet is an enjoyable trail race in the Fylleryd nature reserve, organized by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn. There are two distances, 8.4 km and 4.4 km. The long course follows much of the Trestugespåret and becomes hilly towards the end, while the short course follows the floodlit trail. Both races start together at VAIS-torpet at 18:30, and the event ends with refreshments. The race is free for Växjö AIS members; non-members pay an entry fee of 50 kronor.
course_highlights: Hilly recreational trail through the Fylleryd nature reserve
The long course (8.4 km) follows much of the Trestugespåret and is particularly hilly towards the end
The short course (4.4 km) follows the floodlit trail, and both courses finish with a long hill up to VAIS-torpet
additional: Race information will be published on April 28; a map and course profile are available as a PDF; registration is stated to open via a form (new tab) on the event page; the event ends with refreshments at VAIS-torpet. Trail race in Fylleryd Forest with start and finish at VAIS-torpet; spring and autumn events; membership affects the entry fee.

name: Vårruset Uppsala
description: Vårruset Uppsala is a women’s fun run organised by Marathongruppen in Uppsala on 7 May 2026. The event offers 2.5 km and 5 km distances, starting and finishing at Studenternas IP. Participants can enter individually or as part of a five-person team, and can opt out of timing for a more relaxed experience. After crossing the finish line, teams are treated to a picnic, with a focus on community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Studenternas IP in Uppsala
Distances of 2.5 km and 5 km
Enter as a five-person team or individually; timing is optional
additional: Distances: 2.5 km and 5 km; open to women of all ages; online registration; early registration is encouraged; teams consist of five people; teams are offered a picnic after the finish. The 5 km course is officially measured. Registration is available until race day, up to one hour before the first start, and timing can be optional.

name: Bankvarvet
price_range: 125 kr/vuxen, barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis
description: Bankvarvet is a fun run in Kisa, taking place on 7 May 2026. The event focuses on the joy of being active rather than achieving a personal best or running the fastest lap, and welcomes participants of all ages and abilities. Entertainment, activities and food experiences are also on offer throughout the day, making it a festival for the whole family and groups of friends. Bankvarvet encourages community spirit and setting your own goals, whether you walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
Focus on the joy of being active and setting your own goals
Family-friendly event with entertainment and activities
additional: The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00 and has over 2,000 participants. It includes entertainment, activities and food experiences. Participants are encouraged to sign up with friends or family for an even more enjoyable experience. Ultramarathon runner Frida Södermark shares training tips ahead of the race via the bank’s social media. The race starts at 18:30 in Kullaparken, Kisa; activities for the whole family; businesses can take part; entertainment and food throughout the day.

name: Valio Helsinki City Run
description: Valio Helsinki City Run is Finland’s largest running event, bringing more than 24,000 runners from over 110 countries to Helsinki Olympic Stadium and the city streets. The event offers six different running distances, including a marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 5 km run and walk, and the children’s Minimarathon. The routes are scenic and coastal, and the finish is at Olympic Stadium. The event also offers a wide range of services, such as world-class timekeeping, refreshment stations, and free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run.
course_highlights: Scenic coastal routes in Helsinki
Finish and event centre at Olympic Stadium
Officially measured, AIMS-certified routes
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Olympic Stadium before the race. Payment with sports benefits is available (ePassi, Edenred, Zevoy Benefits). Group registration requires at least 5 runners. Groups of at least 10 people receive free event shirts. Free entry to the Swimming Stadium after the run. Refreshment stations and gels along the route. Cancellation insurance is available for purchase. Free group training sessions and training plans. World-class timekeeping (excluding the walk). The event includes several distances, such as the marathon, half marathon, 5 km run, and walking events. Participants can follow live results and get their certificates as soon as they finish. The event takes place at Olympic Stadium and also includes an event week with activities and sponsorship opportunities.

name: 45. Tartu Maastikumaraton
description: The 45th Tartu Forest Marathon is a traditional event held at the Tartumaa Sports Centre, offering participants the chance to enjoy trail running in beautiful natural surroundings. The event is part of Estonia’s programme to promote recreational physical activity and is suitable for runners of different abilities who want to improve their fitness and mental well-being. The marathon highlights the importance of physical activity for maintaining health and well-being and invites everyone who leads an active lifestyle to take part. It is organised by the Centre of Excellence for Physical Activity, which supports the development of a healthier and more active society in Estonia.
course_highlights: Trail running through the beautiful forest landscapes of the Tartumaa Sports Centre
A varied and changing course suitable for runners of different abilities
An opportunity to enjoy nature and improve mental and physical health
additional: The event takes place at the Tartumaa Sports Centre. Participants can register and collect their race numbers at Turu 10 in Tartu and in the car park at Aura Centre.

name: RAHOLAN KYMPPI (TAMPERE)
location: Tampereen Tesoman jäähallin parkkipaikka, Tampere, Pirkanmaa, Finland
description: Raholan Kymppi is an annual 10-kilometre running event starting from the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere. It gives runners the chance to enjoy a course that is traditional and popular with locals. The event is part of the running calendar organised by Team Rahola and attracts a diverse range of participants. It is a good opportunity to test your fitness in spring and experience the sense of community at a running event.
course_highlights: A 10-kilometre course
Start and finish at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere
A traditional local running event popular with the community
additional: Team Rahola's Monday group runs from Tesoma Ice Hall at 18:00 offer an opportunity to train. No specific start times or prices are listed for the running event. Team Rahola also offers other running events and training sessions, such as the Cooper test and weekly events. The event takes place at the parking lot of Tesoma Ice Hall in Tampere, and participants can run or walk. The event offers a chance to enjoy exercise in surroundings that combine nature and the city.

description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a family-friendly recreational running event starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometres through the town. There is also the KyrkRundan, approximately three kilometres long, and a free children’s race. The event features music and activities along the route and is a local celebration that welcomes walkers, joggers and runners alike. You are warmly welcome to a day of movement, togetherness and fun on Saturday, 9 May 2026.
course_highlights: Six kilometres, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby
Approximately half of the route runs close to the Svartån River
99 percent asphalt; a few challenging uphill sections and the final kilometre through central Mjölby towards Gästisparken
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Intersport on Friday, 8 May, 12:00–18:00 (a 25% discount coupon is provided when collecting your number). Uncollected race numbers will be distributed in Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. The tab at the top of the race number is the timing chip—without it, no time will be recorded. Late registration is available 30 April–7 May via the website, and can also be completed at race-number collection on 8 May or in Stadsparken on 9 May (Swish only). Fitness4You will lead the warm-up. Refreshments are provided by, among others, ICA Supermarket Mjölby, with water and sports drinks from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Participant numbers have been high in previous years, with 1,074 runners mentioned in coverage of the event. Registration for 2026 opens, and results and records are published by the event’s organising media.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a local running event in Hultsfred, following a pleasant, flat course along Lake Hulingen. There is a 10 km course and two children’s races, and the organizers welcome both club runners and recreational runners. Children can also enter the longer course if they wish. For more information, the organizers refer participants to the race-day information on the event page.
course_highlights: Flat course along Lake Hulingen
10 km for adults and two different children’s races
A pleasant, family-oriented event setting at Herrstorpet
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00 and the 10 km race starts at 11:00. You do not need to belong to a club to participate. The organizers refer participants to the race-day information for more details. The children’s races start at 10:00 according to the schedule; Strandmilen is part of Herrstorpet New Building Day, with rail-bike rides, guided tours and a concert during the morning.

name: Åstöloppet Trail
description: Åstöloppet Trail is a welcoming trail race through Åstön Nature Reserve, taking place on May 9, 2026. The event offers four distances (1, 4, 8 and 14 km) and features a mix of wide forest paths, technical sections and off-trail terrain. The start and finish are at Skeppshamn, and the race promises a scenic seaside finish, making it suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The event is organized by Tynderö IK, and the race director can be reached at the contact address provided.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km
A mix of wide forest paths, technical sections and off-trail terrain
Start and finish at Skeppshamn, with coastal views in Åstön Nature Reserve
additional: Date: May 9, 2026. Distances: 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km. Start and finish at Skeppshamn in Åstön Nature Reserve. Race director Linus can be reached at race.tyndero@gmail.com. The event debuted in 2025, and the 2025 results are published on the page. The Åstöloppet Trail distances are 1 km, 4 km, 8 km and 14 km. The terrain includes wide forest paths, technical sections and off-trail terrain through Åstön Nature Reserve. Start and finish at Skeppshamn; registration is available via the link on the organizer’s page.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
location: Kolmården, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 10 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.description: Till och med 3 Maj: 21 km 400 kr, 11 km 300 kr, 6 km 200 kr, Ungdom 50 kr, Kidz 50 kr.

late_fee.price: 21 km 500 kr; 11 km 400 kr; 6 km 300 kr; Ungdom 50 kr; Kidz 50 kr

description: Kolmårdstrailen is a hilly, experience-focused trail race in the scenic Kolmården area, with technical trails, rocky slabs and plenty of elevation gain. You can choose from courses of approximately 21 km, 11 km and 6 km (as well as a 500 m children’s course). The course is described as challenging but close to nature. It passes, among other places, through Rödgölens Nature Reserve and offers beautiful views from Kolmården’s highest point. The organizer emphasizes the experience and provides services including a water station and downloadable GPX data for your watch.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical trail terrain with plenty of elevation gain and sections of rocky slabs
Passes Rödgölens Nature Reserve and Lake Ågelsjön; views from Kolmården’s highest point (171 m above sea level)
Small trails and singletrack, a wooden bridge over marshy sections, a rope in “koklämman” and a tough, partly off-trail final kilometre
additional: Regular registration is open through 3 May; late registration is available online until 6 May and then on site on race day from 09:00 to 11:00, with payment by cash or Swish. GPX data for the courses is available to download. There is a water station after approximately 7.5 km at Scoutstugan. A children’s race of approximately 500 m is available for children up to age 10. For Kolmården Night Trail, bring a headlamp; the course is marked with reflectors, there are no shower facilities, and chanterelle soup is served at the finish. The organizer offers cancellation and accident insurance as optional extras. The Kolmården events in the series include Kolmården Vertical (5 km, 300 metres of elevation gain), Swimrun Kolmården, Kolmården Night Trail (9 km) and Luciatåget (7.5 km). A results page is available, and multiple distances are emphasized during the event.

name: Östhammars Stadslopp
description: Stadsloppet 2026 is organised by Östhammars Friidrott and takes place on Saturday, 9 May 2026, starting at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar. The event is presented on the club’s competition page and is aimed at local runners and participants from the surrounding area. The necessary contact details are collected during registration for race administration and publication of results, and photos from the event may be used on the club’s channels.
course_highlights: Start at Frösåkersvallen in Östhammar
additional: The club states that contact details provided during registration are used for race-related communication, and that names, ages and results may be stored for results lists and competition statistics. Photos from events may be used on the club’s website, Facebook and Instagram; participants can contact the club to request their removal. Club membership for 2026 is managed through Svenska Lag. The webpage contains the start list, registration and results for Stadsloppet 2025.

name: SHE Silverlöpet
organizer: Sala-Heby Energi AB (i samarbete med IFK Sala)

tiers.label: tier_1

description: SHE Silverlöpet is a relaunch of the classic Silverlöpet, organised in collaboration with SHE. The race runs through central Sala and its beautiful surroundings, with the start and finish in Stadsparken. Choose 10 km (course measured), 5 km or a 2 km children’s race. The race is open to everyone and is presented as a community festival, with a medal for all participants.
course_highlights: Through central Sala and around Sala’s beautiful surroundings
Start and finish in Stadsparken, Sala
The 10 km course has been officially measured
additional: Registration is via Mitt Lopp (opens 2026-03-01). Online registration is open until the beginning of May; late registration takes place on site on 9/5 (5–10 km: 08:00–09:00, children’s 2 km: 08:00–09:15). Prizes and awards: a medal for all participants; prizes for 1st–3rd place in the women’s and men’s 10 km races; prize draws for the 5 km. Silverlöpet is being relaunched in Sala; the most recent race was held in 1999. The distances are 5 km and 10 km. The event is advertised by Sala-Heby Energi AB in collaboration with IFK Sala.

name: Spångaloppet
location: Spånga IP, Spånga, Stockholm Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Spångaloppet is a local running race organised by Spånga/Bromstens Bandyklubb, returning on 9 May 2026. The race offers courses for different ages and ability levels: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and past Spånga centre, a 2 km course for younger runners, and a 400 m children’s race. All races start and finish at Spånga IP. Everyone is welcome to take part, and registration is via RaceID under Spångaloppet 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km through beautiful natural areas and Spånga centre
2 km course for younger runners and a 400 m children’s race
All races start and finish at Spånga IP
additional: Register via RaceID under “Spångaloppet 2026”. For questions, contact spangaloppet@sbbk.nu. All races start and take place in the vicinity of Spånga IP. Registration via RaceID; questions to spangaloppet@sbbk.nu.

name: Sommarro Snabbare

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1 maj - 9 maj 595 SEK Begränsat antal platser.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1 maj - 9 maj 130 SEK. Efteranmälan. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique, fast-paced running race in the Sommarro cultural reserve in Örebro. The race follows a 2.6 km loop through a wooded park setting, with each lap having to be completed in progressively less time (the first lap in 25 minutes, the next in 24 minutes, the third in 23 minutes, and so on), making the race faster with every lap. Everyone starts on equal terms, and the winner is the one who lasts the longest—making it suitable both for fast runners and for those looking to challenge their endurance. There is also Lilla Sommarro Snabbare for children born in 2013 or later (one lap, no timing).
course_highlights: 2.6 km loop in a beautiful wooded park setting (Sommarro cultural reserve)
Hilly course, mostly gravel and fitness trails, with some off-road sections
Start/finish on a lawn; the race uses progressively faster lap times
additional: Mandatory race briefing at 10:45; warm-up with Nordic Wellness before the start. Timing is done with a transponder worn around the ankle (number of laps is the main factor in placing; if tied, the time on the final lap decides). A lost transponder incurs a charge of 800 SEK. Water/sports drink (Umara) and an energy station are available, along with light refreshments. Changing facilities/showers are not available; there are two public toilets nearby. Parking at Sommarro Värdshus and Lugnets IP; city bus 7 stops at Halltorpsvägen.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay, being held for the 47th time, and offers a fantastic running experience on Öland as spring gets underway. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and the race comes in two formats: a longer course with eleven legs, totalling 67.5 km, and a shorter course with six legs, totalling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs for all levels. Event staff and a race announcer follow the race to provide the best possible service and atmosphere throughout the event.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 2.7 km to 8.5 km, 67.5 km total
Short course: 6 legs, 2.7 km to 5.4 km, 23.5 km total
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead a group warm-up before the start. Individual leg times, split times and teams’ finish times will be provided. The race announcer will follow the leaders from start to finish. Accommodation and food are available at Ekerum Resort and Best Western Plus Kalmarsund Hotell. Registration is open until 30 April 2026, with late registration available through 6 May. Participants can look forward to a well-organised event with event staff, a group warm-up and a prize-giving ceremony for the top teams.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://olandrunning.se/lopp/olands-kyrkstafett/): 2026-05-09 — "Tid & datum 09 maj 2026 kl. 10:00" (was estimated 2026-05-09)

name: RASA Druskininkų maratonas
organizer: Asociacija Sporto renginiai ir Druskininkų sporto centras
description: The RASA Druskininkai Marathon is an international running event held in Druskininkai by Lake Vijūnėlė. The event promotes running as a healthy lifestyle, aims to popularize athletics in Lithuania, and encourages greater physical activity among Druskininkai residents. Anyone may take part in the competition, but participants in the marathon and half marathon must be at least 18 years old. Runners can choose from distances ranging from 500 m to the marathon, and all participants receive special event medals.
course_highlights: 500 m, 5 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, and marathon distances
Starts from 10:00; time limits are 5 hours for the marathon and half marathon distances
The race takes place by Lake Vijūnėlė in Druskininkai
additional: Starts take place in waves: 10:00 – 500 m (untimed); 10:17 – 5 km (43-minute time limit); 11:00 – 10.5 km, half marathon, and marathon (5-hour time limit). Participants must compete under their own names. Participants in the marathon and half marathon must be at least 18 years old. All participants receive special event medals, and trophies are awarded to the top three finishers. Distances: 500 m, 5 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, marathon; online registration; awards for the top finishers.

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route, serving as the first stage of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. The event will take place on 9 May 2026 and offers an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and to discover local attractions such as the largest wooden clog and a communal feast table. Participants can prepare by using the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.
course_highlights: Red route, 8.2 km long
Scenic but challenging terrain
Local attractions: a communal feast table, the largest wooden clog and a snuffbox
additional: The event starts at 11:00. Registration is open from 18 March 2026 to 7 May 2026. The route passes through the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality, encouraging participants to use the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the region. The event offers sporting challenges, beautiful views and local attractions to enrich participants’ Nordic Walking experience.

name: Red Bull Wings for Life World run
description: Red Bull Wings for Life World Run is a unique race held simultaneously around the world, including in Vingis Park in Vilnius. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the Catcher Car. The event supports research into spinal cord injuries, with 100% of the entry fee going to research. Join thousands of runners around the world and run for those who can’t.
course_highlights: The run takes place in Vingis Park, Vilnius
Starts simultaneously with runners around the world
A unique Catcher Car format that ends the run
additional: The start is at 11:00 UTC. Participants run as far as they can until they are caught by the Catcher Car. 100% of the entry fee goes to research into spinal cord injuries. The event takes place simultaneously around the world, including in Vilnius. It takes place in Vingis Park; participants can choose to run or walk; there is no traditional finish line; funds are raised for spinal cord injury research.

name: A.Vietrino taurės bėgimo varžybos
organizer: Lietuvos lengvosios atletikos federacija, Kauno bėgimo mėgėjų klubas, Lietuvos sporto universitetas
description: The A. Vietrinas Cup running race is held in memory of Alfonso Vietrinas, a pioneer of marathon running in Lithuania. The race takes place in Kaunas Oak Grove Park, with the start and finish by the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas. Participants can choose between the 2.5 km and 10 km distances. The course is certified and consists of a 2.5 km loop. The event promotes running in Lithuania and welcomes everyone who has a doctor’s approval to participate.
course_highlights: The course runs through Oak Grove Park
The certified course is a 2.5 km loop
Start and finish by the monument to S. Darius and S. Girėnas
additional: The 2.5 km race starts at 11:30, and the 10 km race starts at 12:00. Participants must wear their race number on the front of their shirt. Age-group winners and placing participants, as well as the youngest and oldest participants, receive commemorative cups. The use of vehicles and personal escorts is prohibited during the race. The event aims to encourage physical activity and build a community of running enthusiasts in Lithuania.

name: Tarptautinės bėgimo varžybos „Kresowe Trail“
location: Nemenčinės apylinkės, Nemenčinė, Vilniaus rajonas, Lithuania
organizer: Vilniaus rajono savivaldybė, Vilniaus rajono sporto centras, Vilniaus rajono sporto mokykla, fondas Maratony Kresowe
description: The international “Kresowe Trail” running competition in Nemenčinė offers a unique opportunity to run through the surroundings of the Vilnius District Sports Centre. The competition takes place on June 2, with routes of varying lengths—from the shorter 6 km Szpurt run to the longer 18.6 km Wertep route. The event is suitable for both professional and recreational runners, with electronic timing and a race bib valid for the entire season. Participants can enjoy routes marked with green and red arrows, and awards and hot food await after the run.
course_highlights: Szpurt 6 km run marked with green arrows on a yellow background
Wertep 18.6 km run marked with red arrows
Two refreshment stations on the Wertep route
additional: Registration takes place before the start, from 8:30 to 9:20, no later than 10 minutes before the start. The race office is open on June 1 from 15:00 to 18:00 at the Vilnius District Sports Centre. The course time limit is 2 hours 15 minutes. Electronic timing and a free race bib with a timing chip, valid for the entire season. Hot food is offered to participants after the run. Starting areas are separated by distance: Szpurt 6 km and Wertep 19 km. The event includes refreshment stations, electronic timing, a free race bib, medical coverage, and awards.

name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race held simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will take place on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is an approximately 3 km loop on a paved surface, with a minimal uphill section on the connector. All entry fees support spinal cord research.
course_highlights: An approximately 3 km walking and running loop
Paved surface, uneven in places near the large reservoir
A minimal uphill section on the connector toward the smaller reservoir
additional: The race is open to runners and participants using wheelchairs. The Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the runners at a speed of 14 km/h and gradually speeds up. 100% of entry fees go toward spinal cord research. Participants use the Wings for Life World Run app to follow the race and results. The race starts at 13:00, and participants use the app to register and track their progress. The event is open to runners and wheelchair users.

name: Vårruset (Växjö)
description: Vårruset Växjö is the Växjö edition of Sweden’s largest women’s running tour, which visits 19 cities in 2026. In Växjö, participants can choose between 2.5 km and 5 km, starting and finishing at Strandbjörket, around Lake Växjö. You can register individually or as part of a team. A medal, a finish-line bag and the Vårruset music quiz with prizes are included, while timing is optional. Age recommendations apply, and registration is online. As an extra new feature, free HPV vaccination is available on-site during Vårruset for women born in 1994–1999, according to Region Kronoberg.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or 5 km around Lake Växjö, starting and finishing at Strandbjörket
Team and individual registration; teams can enjoy a picnic after the finish
Medal, finish-line bag and the Vårruset music quiz with prizes (timing is optional)
additional: Team picnic after the finish; online registration; part of the national Vårruset tour in 2026 (19 cities). Distance options: 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured). Start and finish at Strandbjörket; teams of 5 are treated to a picnic after the finish. You can register online up until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start; you can opt out of timing when registering.

name: Šventinis bėgimas „Kuršėnams 463“
location: Kuršėnų pėsčiųjų tiltas, Kuršėnai, Šiaulių rajonas, Lithuania
price_range: nemokamai, 3-5 Eur, registracijos mokestis iki 2026-05-13 d. 23:59, vėliau 10 Eur

description: The festive “Kuršėnams 463” run is a traditional running event held in Kuršėnai, Šiauliai District. The event aims to promote running and encourage a healthy lifestyle, inviting runners of all ages to take part. The races take place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge, with three distances on offer: approximately 463 m, 2.5 km, and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a symbolic route and a friendly atmosphere, and the event concludes with awards and a joint finish at around 21:30.
course_highlights: A symbolic route of approximately 463 m by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge
A 2.5 km loop that 10 km runners complete four times
The races take place in an urban setting, with a convenient start and finish
additional: Race schedule: 19:30 — 463 m start; 19:40 — 2.5 km start; 20:00 — 10 km start. Awards take place after the last participant finishes, at around 21:30. Participants must be healthy or have a doctor’s clearance to exercise. The health and conduct of underage participants are supervised by accompanying adults. The race takes place by the Kuršėnai pedestrian bridge; registration and race-number pickup are by the bridge; participant age groups; COVID-19 safety requirements.

name: V Nocny Bieg Parami ze Świetlikami
description: The V Night Run in Pairs with Fireflies is a unique night running event held in Reda, by a retention reservoir. The runners’ headlamps and the illuminated course create a spectacular visual effect. Participants start in pairs, highlighting the event’s inclusive character and setting it apart from other sporting events in the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The run takes place after dark, adding a distinctive atmosphere and excitement.
course_highlights: The run takes place after dark, with runners using headlamps
The course is located by the forest and retention reservoir in Reda
Pairs start together, with spectacular lighting along the course
additional: The start line closes 5 minutes after the starter’s signal. The event headquarters are in Reda, at the end of Karłowicza Street, by the forest and retention reservoir. Race numbers can be collected on site. The organizer is not responsible for valuables. The first pair is expected to finish between 22:00 and 22:15. night run, limited number of participants, distance over 15 km, area around Reda, start in the town center by the retention reservoir

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Skärholmen, taking place for the fourteenth time in 2026 on Saturday, May 16. The event offers a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over, a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages, and the Lilla and Mini races for children. Registration is free through the #RUN4ZERO initiative, and everyone who completes the race receives a specially designed medal. Löparakademin, a non-profit association that works with youth programs, is the organizer.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race, starting and finishing at Puckelbollplanen
DJs and music stations along the route create a suburban festival atmosphere
Children’s races: Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approx. 1.6 km, and Mini, approx. 500 m
additional: Online registration closes Thursday, May 14 at 5 p.m., but late registration is available at bib collection on Friday, May 15, and on race day, May 16, subject to availability. All participants must have a bib, which is distributed well ahead of the race. Everyone who completes the race receives a medal; Lilla participants are also offered fruit and a drink at the finish. The start/finish is at Puckelbollplanen, and Lilla/Mini have separate start times and age-grouped start fields. The race takes place in Skärholmen, Stockholm, and is free to enter through RUN4ZERO, with a medal for everyone who completes it.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Welcome to Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka in Ånnaboda, a friendly trail race where you choose how far you want to run. The race consists of three out-and-back routes that can be combined to make 10, 26 or 54 km. They offer hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with both technical sections and easy-to-run trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same race centre, creating a social atmosphere where runners meet several times throughout the day. The event is organised by the Trail and Run association and offers an aid station, a drop-bag option and a simple hot meal after the finish.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes from Ånnaboda, with options of 10 km, 26 km or 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and scenic trails
The Bergslagsleden trail is included, with a turnaround point at the Rusakulan viewpoint; everyone starts at the same place and time, creating a social atmosphere
additional: Maximum 70 participants. Race numbers can be collected at the race centre from 08:00. The entry fee is paid via Swish to 123 118 33 18 — include your name as the payment message. Runners must carry all the equipment and energy they need on the course; there is no support along the route, only at the race centre. The race centre has an aid station with water, Umara sports drink, bananas, sweets and more; you can leave your own drop bag there. A simple hot meal is served after the finish (vegetarian option available). Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at SM-stugan (lower car park). Parking is recommended at the lower car park. Three out-and-back routes (10/26/54 km) from Ånnaboda; maximum 70 participants; registration deadline 15 May; start at 09:00 on 16 May 2026; aid station, drop bag and meal after the finish.

name: Vistakulle Backyard
distance_verbose: 50 miles, Marathon, 6.7 km, 3.5 km, Backyard Ultra
description: Vistakulle Backyard is a running event in the Vistakulle area near Gränna, organized by Rudu Friskvård in collaboration with Bauer Activities. The race is aimed at people with a sense of adventure and an interest in fitness, and emphasizes the experience of nature as much as performance. The event takes place on 16 May 2026 and offers a memorable course through scenic, hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Hilly trails and slopes in natural surroundings
Varied terrain: trails, gravel roads and asphalt
Beautiful views of Lake Vättern and the surrounding forest
additional: Now organized by Rudu Friskvård. Event hours are listed as 07:00–19:00 on 16 May 2026. Bauer Activities emphasizes that its races are suitable for both beginners and experienced participants, and that the areas (Östra Vätterbranterna) are a UNESCO-designated biosphere with a strong focus on nature. Part of the Gränna StadsTrail program. Registration/contact: info@baueractivities.se.

name: Örbyhus half-marathon (10K) - Örbyhus
location: Örbyhus, Tierp Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden

name: HANNER bėgimas į dangoraižį „Europa“
location: Europa Tower, Vilnius, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The HANNER Run Up the Europa Skyscraper is a traditional annual challenge, inviting running enthusiasts and extreme sports fans to climb all 31 floors of the Europa business centre, the tallest in the Baltic States. The event brings together professionals and amateurs looking to improve their endurance and athletic performance. The course must be completed in no more than 10 minutes, while prize winners usually finish in 3–4 minutes. The fastest runners receive cash prizes and gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: 31 floors of the business centre up to the terrace
Course completion time: up to 10 minutes
Records stand at 2 min. 55.6 sec. in the men’s category and 3 min. 28.6 sec. in the women’s category
additional: Participants start every half-minute to avoid congestion. The fastest runners receive cash prizes and gifts from sponsors. The event is organised by real estate development company Hanner and the Lithuanian Running Cup team. The event is scheduled for May 22, 2027, and welcomes participants from across Lithuania and abroad. Participants are invited to climb Europa Tower, and the event is known as one of the most interesting and challenging running events in Vilnius.

name: XIII Olecka Trzynastka
location: Stadion Miejski w Olecku, Olecko, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: w dniach 4 maja – 15 maja oraz w dniu zawodów - 50 zł

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: dla wszystkich uczestników biegu głównego stała kwota w wysokości 70 zł

description: The 13th Olecka Thirteen is an annual race held at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko. The event includes a main race and Nordic walking, attracting both runners and outdoor enthusiasts. It is open and welcoming to participants, with clearly defined entry fees and professional organization. The start is scheduled for 08:30, and the event runs until 14:20.
course_highlights: A route around Lake Oleckie Wielkie
Flat, gravel route
Additional children’s and youth races, and a Nordic walking event
additional: Entry fees must be confirmed by bank transfer to oleckobiega@wp.pl. The event is organized by VALDANO, with Willa na Kozińcu as a partner. It takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Olecko, with registration available from January to May 2026. Participants can enjoy a variety of competitions and sporting attractions, as well as beautiful views and an atmosphere conducive to active recreation.

name: Kajenloppet
organizer: Nacka Hockey och Kajen i Nacka strand
description: Kajenloppet is a running festival in Nacka Strand on 17 May 2026, offering 10 km and 6 km races, as well as two children’s races (1,200 m and 400 m). The course follows a scenic route along the water, passes historic sites and offers views of Stockholm’s inlet. The start and finish are at Kajen in Nacka Strand, and the event is combined with a family festival featuring activities, music and entertainment. The race celebrates local pride and is suitable for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the water
Passes historic sites and offers views of Stockholm’s inlet
Start and finish at Kajen in Nacka Strand; family festival with activities and music
additional: Distances: 10 km, 6 km, and children’s races of 1,200 m and 400 m. Date and location: 17 May 2026, Kajen in Nacka Strand. Start and finish at the same location, at Kajen. The day includes a family festival with activities, music and entertainment. Part of the registration fee goes to Min Stora Dag.

name: Vårruset Stockholm
description: Vårruset Stockholm is part of Sweden’s largest women’s recreational running tour and takes place on Tuesday, 19 May 2026, in Norra Djurgården. Choose between a 2.5 km distance and a measured 5 km course. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and experienced runners, with a warm, community-focused atmosphere. You can enter as a team and finish the evening with a picnic after the race. Registration is online, and the same price applies whether or not you choose to have your time recorded.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Norra Djurgården
The 5 km course is measured
Nearest metro station: Universitetet
additional: Included are a medal, a finish-line bag, the Vårruset music quiz with prizes, a race bib and, for those who choose it, official timekeeping. You can opt out of timekeeping so that your result is not published. Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after the race; team members can run different distances. Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (7 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is binding, and the entry fee is non-refundable in the event of cancellation. There is also a digital race for participants who cannot attend in person (with medals mailed after the tour). Race bibs are mailed to the address provided at registration for entries submitted before a specified date; any surplus goes 100% back to sport.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė - 2026, 1 etapas
description: The Jonava Running Cup is a traditional running competition held in Jonava District to promote sport and physical activity. The event is open to all runners from Lithuania and abroad and takes place in five stages at different locations. Participants compete in both the overall standings and age groups, while the routes pass through various parts of Jonava District, offering an interesting and varied running experience. Registration is online, and race numbers can be collected at the start location on race day.
course_highlights: Five stages at different locations in Jonava District: Šilai–Jaugeliškiai, Ragožiai, Juškonys, Salupiai–Bartoniai, Jonava
Starts and finishes at various locations, including Jonava Central Stadium and eldership buildings
Races take place in the evening, with the start at 19:30 and race-number collection from 18:30 to 19:20
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the start location on race day from 18:30 to 19:20. Registration is carried out separately for each stage. Participation is free. The event is open to all participants, offers online registration and different routes, and takes place in five stages from May to September.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are timed and untimed categories, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part for free, and there is specific information for schools.
course_highlights: Four legs of 4 km each (4 × 4 km in total)
Start, relay exchanges and finish in the beautiful Folkparken
Suitable for walking, jogging or running; timed and untimed categories
additional: Children and young people take part for free thanks to HSB; schools are encouraged to register (school contact: mikael.grip@lopparrangoren.se). The organiser offers tents and event furnishings for hire through Rent a Tent (booking deadline to guarantee availability: 5 May; contact norrkoping@rentatent.se). The start, relay exchanges and finish are all in the park, creating a lively atmosphere for spectators and the event. Teams consist of four participants; event communications mention a picnic bag from ICA Kvantum Mirum Galleria and a medal at the finish. More than 700 participants and around 180 teams took part in previous years; young people and students participate free of charge thanks to sponsorship from HSB and Fiskeby. More information and registration are available at norrkopingsstafetten.se. ICA Kvantum Mirum provides a picnic for all participants; various sponsors offer tents or gathering areas.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women—a fun and welcoming spring evening where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event tours 19 cities between 4 May and 4 June 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and race bib, and teams of five are rewarded with a picnic after crossing the finish line. The race has been held since 1989 and is aimed at recreational runners of different ages, according to the recommendations for each distance.
course_highlights: Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
The 5 km course is officially measured at all locations
Teams of five receive a picnic after crossing the finish line
additional: Individual registration includes a medal, a finish-line bag, timing (for those who have selected it) and a race bib. Team registration includes a picnic after crossing the finish line, a medal, a finish-line bag, timing (for those who have selected it) and a race bib. A team consists of five people, and the picnic voucher is issued only when the entire team (five paying participants) is registered. There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digital), where you can run between 4 May and 4 June and have a medal mailed to you; digital registrations cannot be combined with in-person participation in the tour. Payment is accepted via Swish and Klarna; the wellness benefit platforms Epassi, Benefits and Benifex are supported. Instructions on how to register and information about adding team members are available in the FAQ and registration guide on the website. Free training sessions ahead of Vårruset are offered by Falu IK Friidrott in collaboration with Vårruset and Intersport; two training sessions before the race are listed.

name: Blodomloppet (Karlskrona)
price_range: Individuell: 300-350 kr; Lag (5 personer): 1500-1750 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr; blodgivar-rabatt 40 kr per person
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Karlskrona on 20 May 2026—a recreational event that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, take part in Lilla Blodomloppet (800 m), or walk 5 km. The courses have been measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation, and walkers have a separate route so participants can finish with a picnic together. The event is organised by KA 2 IF and offers individual and team entries, as well as discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four routes: 5 km run, 10 km run, 800 m children’s race and 5 km walk
Walkers have their own route and can set off first, then enjoy a picnic with the others
The courses have been measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation and meet the requirements for competition courses
additional: Organiser: KA 2 IF (Blodomloppet contact: karlskrona@blodomloppet.se, tel. 0793-299924). A team can have up to 5 participants, and team members can take part in different distances. For larger entries, an Excel template is available in the registration system for importing details, as well as the option of a customer page for companies/organisations to manage entries and discount codes in one place. Blood donors and ICA members receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. A picnic after the event is part of the programme. Courses: 5 km, 10 km, 800 m and 5 km walk; Excel template for larger groups; start times and warm-up details will be shared later via the information channel.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is an evening 5 km race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race is run on a 2.5 km loop, completed twice, with a pleasant atmosphere and great spirit along the course. You can take part individually or enter a team (at least five people), with the five fastest times combined. Welcome to the running festival in Stadsparken on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 19:00.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop run twice, with a lap split halfway
Start and finish in Stadsparken; the course runs through central Västervik
The course may be adjusted due to construction work on Storgatan
additional: Race bibs are available for collection well before the start and must be collected before 17:30 on race day. Collection: Monday 18 May – Intersport 11–14; Tuesday 19 May – Intersport 11–14; Wednesday 20 May – at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. Registration is via RaceID (link provided on the event page). Team competition: at least 5 people per team; the team result is the combined time of the 5 fastest participants; if more than 9 participants are from the same organization, multiple teams can be entered. 5 km course; start and finish in Stadsparken; race bibs must be collected before 17:30 on race day or according to the schedule; start at 19:00; VO-Joggen times included in the programme; 20% team discount with code LAG20.

name: Kėdainių bėgimas „Babėnų pavasaris 2026“
location: Babėnų miško poilsio aikštelė, Kėdainiai, Lithuania
description: The Kėdainiai race “Babėnų Spring 2026” invites all active-lifestyle enthusiasts to take part in the 5 km and 10 km distances at the Babėnai Forest recreation area. The event aims to encourage physical activity among participants of all ages and provide an opportunity to compete and put their running abilities to the test. The courses follow forest trails and paths, and every finisher will receive a commemorative medal. The competition is organised in cooperation between the Kėdainiai Sports Centre and the Lithuanian Amateur Runners Association.
course_highlights: The courses follow trails and paths in Babėnai Forest
5 km and 10 km distances
The competition takes place at the Babėnai Forest recreation area, at the end of Aušros and Budrio streets
additional: Additional registration will be available at the start area from 17:00 to 18:15. Race numbers will be issued starting one hour before the start, with distribution ending 15 minutes before the start. Winners and runners-up in each age group will be awarded, as will the three fastest participants in the 5 km and 10 km distances. All finishers will receive commemorative medals. The event is planned for 26 May 2027, but no details about the courses or entry fee have been provided.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and takes place on Thursday, 21 May 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable both for experienced runners and for those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finisher’s bag and a race bib; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km, but you can opt out when registering if you do not want your result published.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lögastrand
The course runs through central Västerås
The 5 km distance is officially measured (2.5 km is also available)
additional: Registration is online and remains open through race day, closing no later than one hour before the first start. Recommended ages: 5 km: 13 years (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km: 11 years (7 when accompanied by an adult). Teams of five receive a picnic after finishing. Participant benefits include a medal, a finisher’s bag, the Vårruset music quiz and prizes, and a race bib. Timing is available for the 5 km but can be opted out of. Local organiser: Västerås FK (www.vasterasfriidrott.se); information about a local training meetup will be published with separate registration via Västerås FK’s registration page. The distances are 2.5 km or 5 km; a team consists of five people, and registration is available as a team or individually. Timing can be opted out of during registration. Registration is online, and a picnic is served after finishing.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
description: Take part in celebrating the life-saving act of blood donation at Blodomloppet Linköping! The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes that you can walk, jog or run, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for younger participants. The event is team- and business-friendly: many people take part in teams of five, and the race traditionally ends with a large picnic. You can register individually or as part of a team, and the organiser offers special discounts for blood donors and youth teams.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km (walk, jog or run)
Suitable for individual participants and teams (3–5 people; often teams of five)
The event ends with a large communal picnic
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (3–5 people); teams always pay for five, and you can add members to make a full team free of charge by 30 April (contact linkoping@blodomloppet.se). Youth teams (all members born in 2009 or later) pay half the entry fee until 30 April. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. The deadline for team registration is 14 May; online registration is open until the start. Everyone who registers by 14 May and provides a mobile number will receive an SMS ticket link for free travel within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day. Race bib collection: 19 May, 11:00–19:00 (GeBlod, Storgatan 32); 20 May, 12:00–18:00 (GeBlod); and 21 May, 16:00–19:00 (Saab Arena). From 1 May, some changes may require an in-person visit. Businesses can get a customer page in the registration system. Discounts for blood donors and information about training before the event are available. The team registration deadline may be in mid-May, and payment methods include Swish, card and e-invoice. The ticket provides free travel within Östergötland for up to 6 hours on race day.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg = 1500 kr

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Lagtävling (3-6 pers) 3,8 km eller 7,6 km inkl picknickkorg = 1500 kr

description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, organised by OK Hällen since 2012. The event is suitable for all ages and running abilities, with distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km, shorter children’s races, and a new dog class in 2026. The courses combine grass, trails and roads through woodland and a residential area. The event is popular with both individual runners and teams/work groups who want to compete together. Teams receive a picnic basket, which can be collected from the catering tent after finishing.
course_highlights: Course on asphalt, trails and grass through woodland and a residential area
Start and finish on the green space next to ICA Nära in Stigtomta
The hill sprint: timing on the steepest hill and prizes along the course
additional: Start times: Little Kids 17:40, Primary/Middle School Class 18:00, Dog 18:15–18:20 (fast dogs first), Adults (including team competition) 18:45. The participant bag and race bib with timing chip must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the relevant start. Teams receive a picnic basket (collected from the catering tent; drinks not included). The catering tent accepts card payments. Parking is available as directed along road 52; cycling is recommended. The dog class is limited to 30 participants, and dog owners must clean up after their dogs. A dog-friendly option will be introduced in 2026, with a separate start for runners with dogs; participants can run, have the dog pull them, or walk in Stigtomta.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The XIII 5-Mile Race is a 5-nautical-mile (9260 m) race organized in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Naval Officers’ Association in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Centre. The course consists of two 4630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP Gen. K. Pułaski. The race is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and civilian runners following prior verification. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Distance: 5 nautical miles (9260 m)—two 4630 m loops
Start and finish in front of the ORP Gen. K. Pułaski
Coastal course in Gdynia, not certified by the PZLA
additional: Payments are processed through Przelewy24. Participants must be verified; foreign nationals may take part after prior agreement with the organizer. The participant limit is 500. Online registration, a post-race meal, and no PZLA certification.

name: Tradicinis bėgimas „Laisvės taku 2026“
description: The traditional “Laisvės taku 2026” run will take place on May 22, 2026, in the town of Šimkaičiai, Jurbarkas District, to mark the 117th anniversary of the birth of General Jonas Žemaitis. This is an 11 km cross-country race starting at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and honours the memory of a Lithuanian freedom fighter. Participants are invited to register in advance and take part in this community sporting event.
course_highlights: An 11 km cross-country race in the Šimkaičiai area
Start at General Jonas Žemaitis’s command post
Bus transport to the start from Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School
additional: Participant registration is open from 9:00 to 9:30. Bib pickup is on 2025-05-23 from 9:00 to 9:30. Registration venue: Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School. The bus to the start leaves from the school at 09:45. Awards are scheduled for 13:00. Participants must have a doctor’s permission or have had a health check. Results will be published publicly. Photos and video footage will be taken during the event for marketing purposes. The event will take place at Šimkaičiai Jonas Žemaitis Basic School; age groups and online registration are available.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika Stadslopp is organised by Ludvika FFI and is a family-friendly city race with several distances for both children and adults. The start and finish are at Charlie Normans torg, and the event includes a toddler race, Lilla Stadsloppet, and 5 km and 10 km races (with the option of running with or without timing). The event takes place on Saturday, 23 May 2026, and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities. There is a bonus associated with the 10 km course record.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Normans torg
Toddler race (ages 0–6), Lilla Stadsloppet (up to age 12), and 5 km and 10 km races
10 km: bonus/prize for a course record
additional: Register via a Google Form (https://forms.gle/Q5BfNzbjmGGyDGy46). Race schedule: 11:00 Toddler race (ages 0–6), 11:30 Lilla Stadsloppet (up to age 12), 13:00 start for the 5 km and 10 km races (with or without timing). The start/finish is between the railway station and the marina at Charlie Normans torg. All races start and finish at Charlie Normans torg; the day's programme includes different races, from a short toddler race to longer running distances.

name: Backyard Ultra Vänge
location: Vänge, Uppsala Municipality, Uppsala County, Sweden
description: Backyard Ultra Vänge is a unique ultrarunning event organized by Hagunda IF, where participants run a 6.7 km loop every hour on the hour until only one runner remains. The race takes place in Vänge, about 7 km outside Uppsala along Route 72, and combines challenging terrain with a scenic natural setting and a strong sense of community. There is also a team competition with a points system that rewards fair average times and larger teams; registration opens on 18/9, and the next race is planned for 23 May 2026.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 6.7 km (6,706 meters)
A trail race in scenic surroundings with challenging sections
A new loop starts every hour on the hour; complete it before the hour ends to continue
additional: The maximum capacity is listed as 180 participants (the page shows 179/180 places filled). The race has a team competition with a points system that removes the highest and lowest results to calculate a fair average and gives bonuses to larger teams. A loop starts every hour, and only those who complete it before the hour ends can start the next loop. Results and past races are published on the event’s results page. Capacity: 180 participants; 179 places filled and 1 place remaining.

name: VirsboRUN
location: Skräddartorpet, Virsbo, Fagersta Municipality, Västmanland, Sweden
description: Welcome to VirsboRUN, a family-friendly trail race at Skräddartorpet on Saturday, 23 May 2026. You can choose to run 1–4 laps of the 5.3 km loop (up to 21.2 km), or let the children take part in the free kids’ race of approximately 800 metres. The course passes through unspoilt nature and Hälleskogsbrännan, with varied trails and beautiful views. After finishing, participants receive a medal and a freshly grilled hamburger.
course_highlights: 5.3 km loop (up to 4 laps) — choose how many laps you want to run
Challenging terrain with approximately 101 metres of elevation gain per lap, including rocky sections and forest trails in Hälleskogsbrännan
Kids’ race, approximately 800 m (free), and an additional water station about halfway around (~2.5 km)
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Stora Ladan from 10:00. The kids’ race is limited to 50 participants, and the women’s and men’s classes are limited to 150 starters. Late registration is available until approximately 1 hour before the start on race day. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and a bag of surprises; freshly grilled hamburgers are also served (including vegetarian options). Relays are permitted (2–4 people), the maximum race time is 3 hours, and participation is at your own risk (no refunds). Participants must wear their race number visibly on their stomach; dogs are not permitted. Virsbo Fire and Rescue Service will be on site. Trail race in the forest near Virsbo at Skräddartorpet; 5.3 km loops with 101 m of elevation gain per lap; free kids’ course (800 m); medals for everyone; freshly grilled hamburgers for all competitors; outdoor gym, parking, changing rooms, showers, sauna, toilets and refreshments on site.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-varvet in Eskilstuna is a city running race where runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race starts and finishes in the city park in central Eskilstuna and offers a run through beautiful urban surroundings, according to official information sources. The date listed for the 2026 edition is 23 May, and the organiser is described as Eskilstuna Municipality. The official Facebook page also promotes a quarter marathon of approximately 10,549 metres, offering an additional distance option.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the city park in central Eskilstuna
Run through beautiful urban surroundings
Distance options: 5 km and 10 km (with consideration for different courses and experience levels)
additional: Official sources list the distances as 5 km and 10 km, with the start and finish in the city park. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 23 May. The Facebook page also promotes a quarter marathon of approximately 10,549 m.

name: If Vilniaus Pusmaratonis 2026
description: The “If” Vilnius Half Marathon is Vilnius’s biggest spring running festival, held in the city’s Old Town. The event welcomes runners of all ages, from children to half-marathon participants. It promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and community spirit. Participants can feel safe knowing that all runners are insured against accidents. The event features a range of distances and a friendly atmosphere that helps build lasting connections among participants.
course_highlights: Start at Cathedral Square in Vilnius Old Town
Half-marathon distance: 21.098 km
Children’s and youth races for different age groups
additional: Participants who register by April 4 receive personalized bibs. Event T-shirts are available for an additional fee. The event includes children’s races starting from age 2, a 4.2 km youth race, and 5 km and 10 km distances with no age limits. Participants receive race packs with a timing chip. The event program includes warm-ups and awards for each distance. Runners of various age groups take part, with several start times and additional activities in Vilnius and the Old Town.

name: Atviros „Trakų Dainiaus bėgimo taurės“ 1000 m rungties varžybos
location: Trakų stadionas, Trakai, Vilniaus apskritis, Lithuania
description: The open 1000 m event of the “Trakai Dainius Running Cup” is an official 1000-meter race held at Trakai Stadium. The event is for both young athletes and recreational runners who want to test their speed and experience a true sporting atmosphere. The competition takes place in a professionally prepared setting, with a clearly marked stadium track. It is a great opportunity to challenge yourself in a classic running event and enjoy the spirit of sport in Trakai.
course_highlights: 1000-meter distance on the stadium athletics track
Professionally prepared stadium course
The competition takes place at Trakai Stadium, Birutės St. 44
additional: Registration is available by email at drasutisbarkauskas@gmail.com. The event takes place at Trakai Stadium, Birutės St. 44. This is an official 1000 m event for both young athletes and recreational runners. The event is included in the endurance sports calendar, and participants can compete and enjoy the sporting atmosphere in Trakai.

name: Bėgimo varžybos Pavelo Fedorenkos ir Kupiškio r. Kūno kultūros ir sporto centro prizams laimėti
organizer: Kupiškio r. kūno kultūros ir sporto centras
description: The running competition for the prizes of Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre invites participants to register and compete. The event is held in Kupiškis to promote sporting activity and community spirit. It is a great opportunity to test your abilities and enjoy running in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The event is open to all age groups
Compete for prizes from Pavel Fedorenka and the Kupiškis District Physical Education and Sports Centre
Location: Kupiškis, Lithuania
additional: The event will take place on May 29, 2027. Registration is available online and via social media.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value being close to nature and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors among greenery and enjoy a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings and scenic beauty
Spring race as part of the Botaniczna Piątka series
additional: The race takes place between 10:00 and 14:00. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts who focus on cross-country races and attractive locations. The event is part of a series of races held in different Polish cities during the spring season. It is open to runners of varying abilities, with the option to take part in a 5 km race. The event promotes outdoor activity and encourages local communities to take up running.

name: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach
description: XV Biegiem po Wichrowskich Lasach is an annual running event organized by the Wichrowo Forest District, attracting people who enjoy spending time actively in nature. The main event is a 10 km race through scenic forest areas. There are also races for children and young people, people with intellectual disabilities, and a Nordic walking event. The start and finish are located at the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters, and participants can take part in a familiarization run on the course.
course_highlights: The race course runs through the Wichrowo Forest District
Scenic forest trails over a distance of 10 km
Race categories for children, young people, people with disabilities, and Nordic walking
additional: The course familiarization run takes place on 6 June at 10:00. The children’s and youth races start between approximately 10:10 and 11:00. The Nordic walking event starts at 9:00 from Garnizonowa Street in Dobre Miasto and covers approximately 10 km. The start and finish of the main 10 km race are at the Wichrowo Forest District headquarters. Main race distance: 10 km; races for children and young people; Nordic walking; pre-race training; online registration until 21 May 2026; Nordic walking time limit: 2 hours.

name: Stadionloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 12.00 400 m barnlopp, född -2019 (0 kr) – ej tidtagning

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 13.00 5 km för män och kvinnor (200 kr)

description: Stadionloppet takes place on Sunday, 24 May 2026, with the start, lap point and finish at the historic Stockholm Stadion. The main event is a 5 km race on a two-lap course around the scenic areas of the stadium, and there are also categories for children and young people. The race is family-friendly and community-focused, organised by Djurgårdens IF Friidrott, with chip timing and prizes for the top three.
course_highlights: Start, lap point and finish at Stockholm Stadion
The 5 km main event follows a two-lap course around the stadium
Children’s and youth categories (shorter courses; some categories are untimed)
additional: Registration via RaceID closes at 09:00 on race day; after that, registration is available on site only. The timing chip is attached to the race bib, and both net and gun times are used; placing is based on net time. Race packs are distributed from 10:00 on race day. Payment by card and Swish is available before race day; on race day, Swish only. Members of Djurgårdens IF Friidrott can register for free using the code sent to them. Everyone who registers receives two football tickets (one men’s match and one women’s match). Medical staff will be on site. DIF Running offers practice sessions on the race course during the spring. The listed distance options include 5 km and shorter distances (400 m, 1.2 km and 2.6 km); the first start is at 12:00. Practice sessions on the race course are offered during the spring.

name: Bėgam už Marijampolę - 2026
description: Bėgam už Marijampolę is a traditional annual running event held in Marijampolė, bringing together participants of all ages. It is not only a competition but also an outdoor gathering for local residents that encourages an active lifestyle and a sense of community. The event features an updated running course where participants can test their endurance in a beautiful Lithuanian city. It also includes the “Einam už Marijampolę” walking tour, with 8 km and 14 km distances and free registration.
course_highlights: Updated running course in Marijampolė
Walking tour with 8 km and 14 km distances
Outdoor event that encourages a sense of community
additional: The “Einam už Marijampolę” walking tour takes place alongside the running event, and registration for the tour is free. The event brings together more than 1,000 participants, from the youngest to the oldest. Organized by the Marijampolė Athletics Sports Club. Event date: May 30, 2027; participant numbers and race distances are not specified.

name: Vårruset Jönköping
description: Vårruset in Jönköping is an evening race held by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken, with distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured). The race is open to participants of different ages, and registered participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. Timing is optional, and teams of five receive a picnic after finishing. The event is organized locally by IKHP Huskvarna and welcomes both recreational and experienced runners for an enjoyable spring evening.
course_highlights: The course runs by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken
Choose between 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured)
Timing is optional and can be declined so that results are not published
additional: Team registration (5 people) includes a picnic after finishing; individual and team registrations include a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. You can opt out of timing during registration so that your result is not published. Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (or 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (or 7 when accompanied by an adult). A free training session is held before the season (for example, 19 March at 18:30 at Rocksjöstadion). Registration is online and can be completed up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Local organizer: IKHP Huskvarna. Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km. Age recommendations: 5 km: age 13 (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km: age 11 (7 when accompanied by an adult). Teams consist of 5 people; the team leader enters their details, and members enter their details before the team registration is submitted. Picnic after finishing. Event area: Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken.

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Hudiksvall, a recreational race that highlights the importance of blood donation. Take part by walking, jogging or running 5 km or 10 km (both timed), or sign the children up for Lilla Blodomloppet. The local event is organised by Strands IF Friidrott in partnership with GeBlod Gävleborg and traditionally ends with a shared picnic. Registration is open, with team registration and group-specific options available.
course_highlights: Choice of 5 km and 10 km distances, both timed
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
Traditionally ends with a picnic after the race
additional: Timing is available for the 5 km and 10 km distances. GeBlod Gävleborg is listed as the local blood donation partner, with a contact telephone number and calling hours. Information pages provide details about race numbers, storage, changing facilities, toilets, water stations and parking. Team activities and a picnic bag for teams are mentioned. Storage near the ice rink/Holmen Arena is limited, and parking may be limited; public transport or cycling is recommended.

description: Gladsheim Finspång City Race is a friendly, festive fun run starting and finishing in Bruksparken in central Finspång. The main race is 7 km on a flat surface through the town, with a shorter AktivRundan and a children’s race (XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan) also available. All participants receive a medal at the finish, and the event is known for enthusiastic crowd support, music and award ceremonies. In 2026, the race celebrates its tenth anniversary and welcomes competitive runners, recreational runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: 7 km through central Finspång on a flat, smooth surface
The course is lined with spectators and music to cheer on the runners
Shorter AktivRundan (about 3.8 km), untimed, and a 1.7 km children’s race
additional: Start and finish in Bruksparken; race-bib collection at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga on Tuesday 26 May, 15:00–19:00; bibs not collected at Coop will be distributed at the start/finish area no later than one hour before the start; the top tab on the bib is the chip that records the time; no shower facilities; everyone who walks, jogs or runs to the finish receives energy products from COOP and a water bottle sponsored by Finspångs Brunnsborrning; medal sponsored by Curt Nicolin Gymnasiet; late registration via the website from 18–25 May costs 395 kr (online), and late registration at bib collection on 26–27 May costs 425 kr (in person). 7 km course through central Finspång (start/finish in Bruksparken); AktivRundan approximately 3.5–3.8 km; XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan 1.7 km for children. Bib collection at Stora Coop Finspång/Viberga; the chip is activated via the tab at the top of the bib; registration and payment via Swish are available; on race day, the event opens at 15:00 in Bruksparken. The 2026 edition is the 10th anniversary; XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan starts at 17:00, and the main race starts at 19:00.

The event offers a 7-kilometre course suitable for all recreational runners, whether you walk, jog or run. Those looking for a shorter challenge can take part in AktivRundan, which is 3.8 kilometres, while children can run the 1.7-kilometre XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan. The event celebrates its 10th anniversary in 2026, with a lively celebration of running, music, prizes and community. After the race, an official After Run offers a chance to relax and mingle.
course_highlights: 7 km city course through central Finspång
AktivRundan: 3.8 km for a shorter distance
XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan: 1.7 km for children

DigFab-Spurten is an optional sprint of approximately 100 metres, with prizes of its own. Prize money and special prizes are awarded to elite runners and age categories. Trail and city race, registration via the website, race-bib collection at Coop, various distances including Lilla Slottsrundan, anniversary celebrations in 2026.
