description: Höstruset is a fast 5 km race in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. There is also a 700 m children’s race for ages 3–7. Information on the website is preliminary and will be updated ahead of the 2026 edition.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Start and finish at Björkhagaskolan (changing rooms and showers are available)
Course measured and certified (measurement date: 2024-09-08); timing by ankle transponder
additional: Late registration from 29 September (at an increased fee) is available through the registration system and on race day (Swish only). Race bibs are distributed on race day. Timing is recorded using an ankle transponder, which must be returned (a fee of SEK 400 is charged for a lost transponder). Parking at the school is very limited; carpooling or parking at Karlslunds Motionscentral is recommended. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. Parking at the school is very limited; carpool or cycle to the area. Late registration incurs a higher fee, and Swish is used on race day. Register via anmalmig.nu; results are available online via Hug Timing.

name: /M.Pirksaare/Türi Tehisjärve jooks, liikumissari 8. Järvamaa Järvede jooksud 11. etapp
description: The Türi Artificial Lake Run is part of the 8th Järvamaa Lakes Run Series, which offers varied running opportunities for different age groups. The course goes around Rava Artificial Lake, with varied surfaces of sand, soil and gravel. The best runners are awarded prizes, and the event is suitable for both recreational runners and young running enthusiasts. The event takes place on October 7, 2026, by Lake Rava in Järvamaa.
course_highlights: Running course around Rava Artificial Lake
Varied surfaces: sand, soil and gravel
Several lake views along the course
additional: Runners are counted in different age groups in the Järvamaa Lakes Run Series. There are separate starting lanes on the course, and the runs are suitable for everyone from toddlers to adults. The best men and women who complete one lap of the lake in the fastest time are awarded prizes. The race is part of the Järvamaa Lakes Run Series, which includes several stages and supports community wellbeing and recreational sport.

name: 42. Munamäe–Võru maastikujooks-kõnd
location: SA Võru Spordikeskuse suusabaas Kubijal, Võru, Estonia
description: The 42nd Munamäe–Võru Cross-Country Run and Walk is part of the Võrumaa running and walking series, offering a variety of distances for both runners and walkers. The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads, offering a varied route in the Võru area. The series also includes shorter distances and runs for toddlers, suitable for participants of all ages. The event takes place at the Kubija Ski Base of the Võru Sports Centre Foundation (SA Võru Spordikeskus), known for its beautiful nature and good trail conditions.
course_highlights: The main distance follows trails and asphalt roads in the Võru area
A variety of distances: approx. 5.9 km, a 1.16 km mini-distance, and runs for toddlers
The route is partly off-road and partly asphalt-paved
additional: The event centre opens at 11:00 at Kubija Ski Base. Buses depart from Kubija for various start locations, including Haanja and Kasaritsa. In addition to running, the series includes walking and runs for toddlers. The route follows asphalt and gravel roads in part and also includes softer terrain within the grounds of the Haanja Recreation and Sports Centre. Shorter distances for children and beginners are also held as part of the event. Registration and maps are available on the organiser’s website. The event supports healthy lifestyles and active community participation.

name: Lääne-Virumaa jooksusari 2026 - 7. Võsu Sügisjooks
description: The Lääne-Virumaa Running Series is a traditional running and walking series offering a variety of opportunities for different age groups and ability levels. Its events take place across Lääne-Virumaa, giving runners beautiful scenery and an enjoyable sporting experience. Võsu Autumn Run is the series’ 7th event. It takes place in the Võsu Laine area and is part of a long-running series. The series aims to motivate people to stay active and enjoy running and recreational sport.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Lääne-Virumaa region
Part of a long-running series
Courses suitable for different age groups and ability levels
additional: The series offers different distances and age groups, including youth and children’s races. Events take place at various locations in Lääne-Virumaa, and the route direction and terrain may vary from year to year. Participants are encouraged to register in good time, but specific registration and pricing details are not available. Other races and activities also take place as part of the Võsu Autumn Run. Registration is online, and participants may receive awards by age group.

name: 71. Viljandi Linnajooks
description: The Viljandi City Run is a traditional distance race held every year on the second Sunday of October in the city of Viljandi. The race follows a route around Lake Viljandi and is one of Estonia’s oldest sporting events, attracting top runners from across the country. In addition to the main race, several mass-participation events take place, including children’s races for different age groups. The Viljandi City Run course is 10.4 km long, offering an athletic and lively experience for both recreational and professional runners.
course_highlights: Race around Lake Viljandi
Course length: 10.4 km
One of Estonia’s oldest distance-running traditions
additional: Children’s races for ages 5–6, 7–8, 9–10 and 11–12, free of charge and without timing. The 5 km fun run starts at 11:00. The award ceremony takes place at 14:00. Registration and race-pack collection at Vabaduse Square from 9:00 to 11:30. The race route closes at 14:30. Race day begins with registration at Vabaduse Square at 9:00, and events run until 14:30. Participants receive medals, and children’s races and a recreational run are also held as part of the event.

name: Sõeru Kevadjooks
description: The Sõeru Spring Run is dedicated to the historic Sõeru spring, located on the Vanamõisa multifunctional health and learning trail. The event aims to promote recreational running, provide an opportunity to compete, and determine the winners in different distances. It is also important to introduce the area, offer the whole family an opportunity to spend active leisure time outdoors, and promote a sporting lifestyle.
additional:
Registration and race starts take place at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 20), Vanamõisa village, Saue municipality, Harju County. Race packs will be distributed on 12 May from 17:00 to 20:00 at the café in Vanamõisa Caravan Park (Vabaõhukeskuse tee 18). On 13 May, race pack distribution and competitor registration begin at 15:00 in the log hall at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre. Race numbers will be distributed until 17:15, and until 16:30 for the children’s runs.

The children’s runs start at 17:00
The main race starts at 18:00
The youth race starts at 18:10
All races start at the Vanamõisa Outdoor Centre. The finish is at the same location.

images.alt_text: Sõeru Jooks 13.05.2026 jooksjad ja linn siluett

name: Kopli Liinide Jooks
description:
The course starts from the Kopli Lines promenade. The route continues through Kopli Käsepark, then along the seashore.

The first half of the route follows the seashore, offering beautiful views of Kopli Bay.

The route also passes through the Paljassaare Conservation Area, a beautiful nature reserve known for birdwatching. We then continue through the Tallinn Water property, where you can see how water is treated, before returning to the promenade.

name: Haaga Run
description: Haaga Run will be held for the ninth time on 8 November 2025 in Helsinki! The event is organized jointly by Runner's High and FC POHU, with 5 km and 10 km race distances. The event features a mass start, making it a great opportunity for running enthusiasts.

images.alt_text: Haaga Run -juoksun voittajat, iloisia ja medaljit kaulassa.
Haaga Run -juoksukilpailuun osallistujia. Lapsi juoksee iloisesti.
Haaga Run -juoksukilpailun kuva, jossa juoksijat juoksevat maastossa.

name: NUTS HEL
description: NUTS HEL is an urban trail running event in Helsinki's Central Park, with three different distances: 6 km, 14 km and 25 km. The event is suitable for both first-timers and experienced runners. The start and finish are at Eläintarha Sports Field, and the longest route takes runners along the trails of the Haltiala Forest Nature Reserve. On Friday evening, NUTS Kids & Juniors is also held for the family's youngest trail runners!

images.alt_text: NUTS HEL -polkujuoksun maaliintulo. Juoksijat lähestyvät voittoa.
Eläintarhan urheilukenttä, NUTS HEL -kisan lähtö- ja maalipaikka.

name: Esi-Teivocup
description: Teivocup is a winter-season test run series held around Teivo Racecourse once a month from November to April. Each race is 5 km, with men’s and women’s categories. The event is for all fitness enthusiasts, whether recreational joggers, competitive runners or marathoners.

images.alt_text: Talvinen juoksukilpailu, jossa osallistujat juoksevat lumisella radalla.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail running event held in Mustijoki, Porvoo, on October 11, 2025. The event offers races on routes of different lengths, including 2 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km, so there is something for runners of all fitness levels. The trail rally is designed especially for younger participants, and adults can safely run alongside the children.

images.alt_text: Kartta Hercules, CA:n alueesta, jossa Hercules Trail Run järjestetään.
Juoksukilpailu, jossa lapset ja aikuiset juoksevat.

name: Nummela Backyard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultrarunning race held on Nummelanharju. The race ends when only one runner remains. The race is run on the orange daytime course, which is 6.7 km long, and the blue night loop, which consists of two 3.35 km laps.

images.alt_text: Nummela Backyard Ultra -juoksukilpailun tunnelmaa. Juoksijat lähellä maalia.
Nummela Backyard Ultra -juoksukilpailun kuva sateisessa säässä. Juoksijat juoksevat maantietä.
Nummela Backyard Ultra -reitin kartta. Oranssi ja sininen lenkki näkyvät.

name: Forssan Puistojuoksu
description: Forssa Park Run is a running event held since 1985 that attracts runners of different age groups. Held once a month, the event draws 100–200 participants, and its scenic route winds through the landscapes along the Loimijoki River. Runners can choose between a 5.8 km and an 11.2 km route, which runs near Forssa city centre through the park of the old cotton mill. The event awards the best runners, and the most active participants in particular receive an annual medal.

images.alt_text: Puistojuoksukilpailun juoksijoita Loimijoen varrella.  Hyvä kuva!
Forssan Puistojuoksun 2023 kausikorttimainos. Juoksijoita ja päivämäärät.

name: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu
description: Kotojärven Ympärijuoksu is a traditional running event held at Mika Waltari School in Pornainen. The event gives participants the chance to challenge themselves in beautiful natural surroundings, and the route is designed to offer a suitable challenge. Last year, 73 people took part, and more than 100 runners are expected this year across the different categories, which include distances of 14.3 km, 6.8 km, and 2.2 km.

name: Dark Run Lahti
description: Dark Run Lahti is a unique fun run held in the fading light of an autumn evening amid the stunning scenery of Salpausselkä. The event offers 5 km and 10 km distances suitable for participants of all fitness levels. Runners travel mainly along outdoor trails by headlamp, and the event also includes the optional Dark Forest horror experience, which adds excitement to the course. The atmospheric event centre is located at Lahti Sports Centre. After the run, there is an awards ceremony and prize draws.
course_highlights: The routes follow unlit outdoor trails through Salpausselkä’s autumn scenery
There are two aid stations on the 10 km route and one on the 5 km route
Optional Dark Forest horror experience on the final forest section
additional: The race uses an electronic timing system, with timing tags attached to race bibs. The awards ceremony is at 20:15, with prizes for the three fastest finishers in the 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as prize draws for all participants. The event centre has showers, saunas and toilets. Participants may run, walk or Nordic walk the distances. The event includes running in the dark, a horror experience and fenced routes; the minimum age is 12. The event is held at Lahti Sports Centre and in the surrounding area.

name: Hercules Trail Run
description: Hercules Trail Run is a trail-running event held for the tenth time, inviting runners to experience Porvoo’s finest trails and seaside scenery in the crisp October air. The event offers a variety of route options for all fitness levels, from the 2 km children’s Trail Rally to a 42 km trail run. Race day begins with the children’s Trail Rally and continues with several distances along beautiful, varied trails in the Porvoo area. The entry fee includes a range of services. Photo and video material will be recorded during the event and used for event communications.
course_highlights: 2 km Trail Rally for children, with no risk of getting lost
Trail runs of 7 km, 14 km, 21 km and 42 km, with different numbers of laps
Stunning seaside scenery at Mustijoki in Porvoo
additional: Start times: 9:00 race office opens; 11:00 2 km Trail Rally; 12:00 7 km; 12:05 42 km; 12:15 21 km; 12:25 14 km. The finish closes at 20:00. The entry fee includes communications and photography. Participants’ names will be published in the start and results lists. Adults may run along with children in the Trail Rally if they can keep up. Trail running, multiple distances, natural terrain, coastal views, registration information, event schedule

description: Säkylänharju Trail Run will take place on Saturday, 10 October 2026, at the Huovinrinne Biathlon Centre in Säkylä. The event offers trail-running enthusiasts a variety of routes, including a section through Klopin monttu. The race centre is easy to reach, and the event is known for its tried-and-tested format. Participants can choose from different distances and enjoy the tranquillity of nature and varied terrain.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Klopin monttu
Race centre at the Huovinrinne Biathlon Centre
Varied trails and peaceful natural surroundings
additional: Late entries can be made at the race office on race day, no later than one hour before your start. The entry fee can also be paid at the race office using the Epassi app. The race centre is at the Huovinrinne Biathlon Centre, with parking at the venue. By registering, you agree to the publication of your name and team details and to the use of photo and video material in the event’s communications. The routes pass through the kettle hollows of the esker and pine heathland; drink stations and a hot meal are included; registration is available in advance and at the event; various categories and distances.

name: Nummela BackYard Ultra
description: Nummela Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon running event in which competitors run 6.706-kilometre loops within an hour for as long as multiple runners are able to continue. The race is unique because it has no predetermined finish time or distance, and the winner is the person who runs one more loop than the others. The event is held at Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers a challenge for runners who value perseverance and endurance. The race originated in the United States and is also known as “Just one more Loop.”
course_highlights: A 6.706-kilometre route to be completed in under an hour
The race continues for as long as multiple runners can complete a loop within an hour
There are often separate daytime and nighttime routes; the nighttime route is less technical
additional: The race uses a start bell that rings every hour. Runners must be in the designated area when the bell rings. Timing may be done on paper or electronically, and timing services are provided by Juha Seppälä (info@nubu.fi). The race ends when only one runner completes a loop within the one-hour time limit. The event is held at Polku Hotel in Vihti and offers the opportunity to take part in an ultramarathon and follow the runners’ progress via GPS.

name: Vantaan Kestävyyskierros
distance_verbose: 100 km, Maraton, 30 km, Puolimaraton, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1500 metriä
description: The Vantaa Endurance Tour 2023 is starting! Sign up for the Vantaa Endurance Tour, where you’ll challenge yourself in five different sports. The tour is suitable for fitness enthusiasts and endurance athletes of all levels, and offers a great opportunity to try completely new sports. In 2023, one registration gives you access to five endurance events in Vantaa, allowing you to focus on training instead of searching for races.

images.alt_text: Hiihtäjä Vantaan kestävyyskierroksen reitillä.  Aurinkoinen päivä ja hyvin hoidettu latu.
Vantaan Kestävyyskierros -logo. Sininen tausta ja keltainen teksti.

name: Valon Kymppi
description: Valon Kymppi is a 10 km running event held every autumn in Jyväskylä. The late start, fading evening light and glow of the city lights along the Rantaraitti create a unique atmosphere for the run. The route has been awarded Finland’s most beautiful transport route. It is flat and fast, and the event centre is Jyväskylä Paviljonki.

images.alt_text: Valon Kymppi -juoksun lähtö Jyväskylässä. Juoksijat valmiina startissa.
Valon Kymppi -juoksija hymyilee ja näyttää peukkua Jyväskylän maisemissa.
Valon Kymppi -juoksija hymyilee ja näyttää peukkua Jyväskylän Rantaraitilla.
Valon Kymppi - Jyväskylän reittikartta. 10km juoksu Rantaraitilla.

name: Nevas Night Run
description: The Nevas Night Run 2026 event will be run or walked on 4 September 2026 in Kalkkiranta, Sipoo. Participants can choose between two distances: 12.5 km and 7 km. The longer distance includes two laps around Byträsket, while the shorter distance is designed for all runners. The revamped event also features new categories and a new start location, bringing participants new challenges and experiences.

images.alt_text: Mainos Nevas Night Run -juoksusta. Juoksija osoittaa banneria, jossa juoksukilpailun logo.
Nevas Night Run logo, jossa juoksijoita ja tähtiä pimeässä.

name: Finlandia Marathon
description: Finlandia Marathon is a running event held in Jyväskylä on 11–12 September 2026. The route follows Jyväskylä’s flat, fast Rantaraitti, which has been awarded the title of Finland’s most beautiful transport route. The event centre is Lutakonaukio and Jyväskylä Paviljonki.

images.alt_text: Finlandia Marathonin lähtö Jyväskylässä. Juoksijat starttaavat.

name: Finlandia Vitonen
description: Finlandia Vitonen is the shortest distance at the Finlandia Marathon and is open to everyone interested in physical activity. Participants can move at their own pace, whether it’s a fast sprint or a leisurely walk. The 5 km route follows Jyväskylä’s Rantaraitti, with the start at Lutakon aukio. The event also features fun, encouraging activities in the start and finish area and along the route.

images.alt_text: Finlandia Vitonen -juoksussa osallistujia. Hyvä kuvaus kilpailusta.

name: Vaasa Maraton
description: Vaasa Marathon will be held on September 6, 2025, at Kaarlen kenttä on Ruutikellarintie in Vaasa. The race start schedule is arranged for different groups, and participants must start their final lap by 3:00 p.m. at the latest. Participants can choose the marathon, half marathon, 10.5 km distance, or the Minimarathon, which is free for children.

name: Masters Athletics Marathon
description: Masters Marathon runners can once again compete with the world’s best runners in their own age groups. WMA is excited to announce that RunInBucharest has accepted the challenge of hosting the World Championships for Masters athletes in 2024. The 2024 World Masters Athletics Marathon Championship will be held on October 13 alongside the Bucharest Marathon, offering a wonderful opportunity to enjoy running in beautiful surroundings, with the course passing the city’s most important landmarks.

images.alt_text: Maratonjuoksijat lähtevät Bukarestin kilpailuun, jossa on tunnusomaista "START"-kyltti.
Bucharestin yö, suihkulähteitä ja valaistuja rakennuksia, jotka sopivat maratonin kontekstiin.

name: Nuuksio Classic Trail
description: Nuuksio Classic is one of Finland’s most iconic trail-running events, offering a unique running experience amid stunning scenery. The race takes place in Nuuksio National Park and attracts runners from Finland and around the world. Participants can choose from different distances, including 42 km and 70 km, and enjoy superb courses, wild forest, and excellent organization. Join us on September 5, 2026!

images.alt_text: Maastojuoksija Nuuksion poluilla järven äärellä, aurinkoisena päivänä.

name: Orimattilan Kymppi
description: The most significant village event to develop in Kuivanto is Kuivannon Kymppi. As a celebration of physical activity, it brings villagers together in late autumn to exercise and organize a sporting event. This outdoor and sporting event, initiated by local residents, was first held in 1981, when 24 participants completed the course. The event has grown into a significant international gathering, with more than 500 participants from countries including Russia, Estonia, Sweden, England and Kenya. Through cooperation between the City of Orimattila and local village associations, the event has been carried forward one year at a time.

name: Matin Muistokymppi
description: Matin Muistokymppi is a running event held on 5 September 2024 in Lieksa. The race gives participants the opportunity to run a 10-kilometer distance through beautiful scenery. The course is designed to be both challenging and enjoyable for runners of all levels. The event is aimed especially at fitness enthusiasts and running fans, and offers an excellent opportunity to enjoy the outdoors and good company. Participants can run or walk, and anyone who wants a time will be timed.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat lähtevät juoksukilpailuun, jossa on paljon osallistujia.
Juoksukilpailu käynnissä, kilpailijat juoksevat märällä asfaltilla.
Ryhmä ihmisiä kävelemässä tai juoksemassa ulkona.

name: Laajavuori Trail Run
description: Welcome to Laajavuori Trail Run, a trail running event in Laajavuori, Jyväskylä, on Saturday, 13 September 2025! This exhilarating event offers stunning routes in the heart of Central Finland’s natural landscape—hills, forests, roots, and breathtaking views. Whether you’re an experienced runner or just starting out on the trails, Laajavuori Trail Run is the perfect way to challenge yourself and enjoy nature while staying active.

images.alt_text: Suomen lippu ja kaunis luontomaisema metsässä ja järvellä.

name: Kaisaniemen Juoksu
description: Kaisaniemi Run will be held on Saturday, 13 September 2025, with 5 km and 21.1 km distances. Registration for the 2025 event is now open – sign up here! The start for both distances is a few minutes’ walk from Eläintarha Sports Field, on Hammarskjöldintie. The courses have been officially measured in accordance with WA standards.

images.alt_text: Nainen juoksee hämärän aikaan. Hyvä kuva juoksusta.

name: Bladhin Loppet
description: Bladhin Run is making a comeback, and we will hold the race on 13 September 2025. This historic running event winds through the beautiful wooden-house scenery of Kaskinen and offers participants an unforgettable experience. The race features several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, a children’s run (500 m), and a rollator run (150 m).

name: Kohnan Lenkki
description: Kohnan Lenkki 2023 will be held on September 16, 2023, and features several different categories for different age groups. The event includes running distances of varying lengths, such as 0.8 km for children and 9.8 km for adults. There are separate categories for girls, boys, women, and men, ensuring a suitable race for all participants. The route passes through scenic surroundings known for their diverse landscapes. The event attracts both recreational runners and competitive athletes, and is an excellent opportunity to enjoy running and nature.

Kansallinen Kymppi offers a unique opportunity to run an official 10,000-metre track race, and the evening culminates in a contest between the national elite.

name: Kullervo Marathon

name: Pirkan Hölkkä ja Kieppi

name: 55. Pirkan Hölkkä 5.10.2025
description:
A jewel of the running season, the icing on the cake: this long-distance running event, held mainly on trails, takes place every year on the first Sunday in October.

The 33-kilometre route from Valkeakoski to Tampere runs along a varied mix of fitness trails, forest roads and trails. Around five kilometres of the route are on asphalt. In addition to the running categories, you can take part in a walking category, which is not timed. The event is organised jointly by Tampereen Taivaltajat ry and Valkeakosken Retkeilijät ry.

Pirkan Hölkkä dates back to 1970. The route has largely remained as it is today. In recent years, the average number of participants has been around 1,000–1,500.
additional:
You can choose from the age categories Women’s Open, N40, N50, Men’s Open, M40, M50 and M60. The start is at the Sahara sports field in Valkeakoski (Tallikatu 11), where the starting gun will sound at 9:30 on Sunday morning. Late registration at the start is available from 8:00 to 9:00.

The event uses gun time, measured from the starting gun until you cross the finish line. At the start, you can choose a position near the start line according to your target time.

The first 3 km of the race are on streets. For the next 3 km, the route follows the fitness trail in the recreational area as far as Leppäjärventie. After that, the route to Rutajärvi (11 km from the start) consists of varied forest trails and a short section of gravel road. The 3.5 km stretch between Rutajärvi and Vähä-Kausjärvi is on forest roads. Of the 5 km between Vähä-Kausjärvi and Taivalpirtti, the first part is on forest roads, followed by forest trails; after crossing Savontie, the route returns to gravel roads.
From Taivalpirtti onward, the route alternates between gravel roads and forest trails until it reaches the recreational trail around Suolijärvi. The final 3 km follow a gravel-surfaced recreational trail between Hervanta and Koivistonkylä. This section still has a few climbs that will test Finnish grit.

The Pirkan Hölkkä route is marked with blue flagging tape, directional arrows and kilometre signs. The organisers have aimed to include as many forest trails as possible. There are six refreshment stations along the route.

The finish is in Nirva, Tampere, in the grounds of Tampere Adult Education Centre (Kurssikeskuksenkatu 11). Paid bus transport to the start is available from the finish area and Tampere city centre, both in the morning before the start and in the afternoon after you finish. You can include transport and the soup lunch sold at the finish area in your entry fee by selecting these add-ons in our online store.

images.alt_text: Juoksijat venyttelemässä ennen 55. Pirkan Hölkkää, lokakuussa 2025.
Kaksi miestä, joilla on Pirkan Hölkkä -lippikset.

name: Pirkan Kieppi 5.10.2025
description:
The jewel of the running season and the icing on the cake, Pirkan Hölkkä is a long-distance running event held mostly on trails. It takes place every year on the first Sunday in October. Together with TU38, we are organizing the much-requested shorter distance, the 14 km Pirkan Kieppi.

Pirkan Kieppi starts at the Pirkan Hölkkä finish area, in the courtyard of TAKK’s Nirva campus, at 11:30. On-site late registration is open from 10:00 to 11:00.
additional:
The route continues via Lahdesjärvi to Vuores, where it winds through the beautiful scenery of this neighbourhood. It then joins the traditional Pirkan Hölkkä route at the Vormisto aid station, from where runners continue to the finish together with the full-distance participants.

Pirkan Kieppi has two open categories, women (N) and men (M). Timing is based on gun time, from the starting gun to crossing the finish line. At the start, you can choose a spot near the start line according to your target time.

name: Mental Health Run
description: Mental Health Run is a charity race that aims to highlight the importance of physical activity for mental health. In Stockholm, the start and finish are at the Swedish Museum of Maritime History, and the course is an easy-to-run 5 km loop around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken. Everyone can take part, regardless of background or fitness level—the event also offers a virtual option.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Swedish Museum of Maritime History on Djurgården
An easy-to-run or walk 5 km course around Djurgårdsbrunnsviken
A course on Djurgården with lake views and urban scenery
additional: A virtual option is available (listed as 10–18 October 2026). The event offers a medal as an optional add-on when registering, as well as the opportunity to donate. Optional items and medals are mailed within one month after the virtual race ends. Information about race bibs and collection is published on the news pages (in previous years, race bibs have been available for collection at Filmstaden Sergel). You can add a medal and donate to psychiatric research; the medal is mailed within one month after the virtual race. The virtual race takes place via the Jogg app from 10–18 October using a special code, and results are displayed in the finish area. Timing is provided by Racetimer. Bag drop, an accessible toilet and refreshments are available. Nordic walking poles are permitted, and dogs must start further back.

name: Hässelbyloppet / Lilla Hässelbyloppet
description: Welcome to Hässelbyloppet on Sunday, 11 October 2026—a fast, well-organised 10 km race through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby in north-west Stockholm. The course is flat, officially measured at exactly 10,000 m and sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The Lilla Hässelbyloppet for children and young people is also held on the same day. This page contains all the information about the course, start, registration and practical details for runners.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km course through Hässelby, Grimsta, Råcksta and Vällingby
Asphalt for most of the course; start on grass and finish on an all-weather track
Two water stations along the course
additional: The event centre is Hässelby Idrottsplats (Loviselundsvägen 100). The start is on a field 400 m from the sports grounds, and Hässelby Gård station is less than a kilometre away. The minimum age for the main race is 14 (born in 2012 or earlier); children aged 5–13 can take part in the Lilla Hässelbyloppet. The maximum time allowed is 2 hours. The course has been officially measured by an approved course measurer and the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. The event is streamed live as part of the adidas Adizero Running Tour, and pacers are available (approx. 37:30–60 min). A live stream of the event is offered according to information from the organiser.

name: Å-stadsloppet
price_range: 5 km: 150–300 kr; 10 km: 250–400 kr; 21,1 km: 300–450 kr; KidsRun: Gratis
description: Å-stadsloppet is a road race in Örebro that showcases the city at its best along the Svartån. On 10 October 2026, participants can choose from 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km and the Ullmax KidsRun for children. The race is organised by KFUM Örebro Friidrott, with the start and race services at Tybblelundshallen. Information is updated regularly on the organiser’s Facebook page. The race courses are officially measured, and the event is held in accordance with the rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Runs along the beautiful Svartån
Passes the scenic Rynningeviken and Wadköping
The 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km courses are officially measured (course measurer Bertil Sundin, 2024-09-22)
additional: Race numbers are distributed on race day at Tybblelundshallen (no ID is required, and you can collect them for multiple participants). Timing uses transponders attached to the foot or ankle, which must be returned at the finish or if you withdraw; a lost transponder is charged at 400 kr. Some participants receive disposable chips attached to their race numbers, which do not need to be returned. Changing facilities and valuables drop-off are available at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations, toilets and medical assistance are available along the course; water and sports drinks are provided on the 10 km and 21.1 km courses and at the finish. Parents may run with their child in the KidsRun at no charge. Half-marathon participants must turn 17 during the year; there is no age limit for the 5 km or 10 km. Register at anmalmig.nu; timing is transponder-based, and race-number collection is at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations are located along the course. The half-marathon has a minimum age of 17; there is no age limit for the 5 km or 10 km.

name: Ultunamilen
description: Ultunamilen is a recreational race in Uppsala offering 5 km and 10 km distances. The results list published for the race on 10 October 2026 shows the men’s events at those distances. The race appears to be organized by Upsala Idrottsförening, with registration handled via SportAdmin. The date of the edition mentioned is 2026-10-10, and results are published in connection with the event.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances
Results published (men’s events) according to EasyRecord
Organized by Upsala Idrottsförening in Uppsala, with registration via SportAdmin
additional: The results page shows 2026-10-10 as the date and lists the 5 km and 10 km distances. Note that external pages (such as the Stockholm update) require login for full information.

name: Nyårsloppet
description:
For the 43rd time, Vallentuna Friidrott invites everyone—from elite athletes to recreational runners and children—to take part in a winter race on the streets and squares in central Vallentuna. Participants and spectators may be met with challenging ice, slushy snow, wonderfully crisp winter weather or a fast asphalt course.
Nyårsloppet is a great way to get a little active before the New Year’s meal and the year’s reflections. And as some people say: “What you do on New Year’s Eve sets the tone for the rest of the year!” So take the opportunity to get active, bring a friend and run or jog around the course.

name: Tjurruset
description: Welcome to Tjurruset in Norra Djurgården—a fun and challenging trail race where determination often matters more than perfect running form. The course features forest trails, muddy sections, wet stretches and technical terrain. Adults can choose between 5 or 10 km. For children, there is Kalvruset (approx. 3 km) and Lilla Kalvruset (approx. 700 m). The event is organised by Marathongruppen together with local athletics clubs and is open to both beginners and experienced participants.
course_highlights: The course in Norra Djurgården features forest trails, muddy sections and wet stretches
Adults can choose between 5 km and 10 km; Kalvruset is approx. 3 km and Lilla Kalvruset approx. 700 m for children
Technical terrain with steep hills, where shoes with good grip are recommended
additional: Practical information: warm showers are available in tents a few minutes’ walk from the finish, along with basic rinsing facilities immediately after finishing. There are collection points for clothes that may not make it home. Kalvruset has a medical first-aid team on site, and all children receive a medal bearing the year. Organised by Marathongruppen in collaboration with Hässelby SK and Spårvägens FK; any surplus goes back to sport. Group registration for companies; corporate tent and meeting point; any surplus goes back to sport.

name: Nyårsloppet Vallentuna
description:
The New Year’s Race is a perfect way to get active during the days between Christmas and New Year. For the 42nd time, Vallentuna Friidrott is inviting runners to take part on New Year’s Eve, with everyone from elite athletes to those who prefer a more relaxed pace. A winter race can mean challenging conditions or fast asphalt—we never know until race day. Keep an eye on the weather forecast and read our information. Statistically, conditions have been favourable for running in most years, as the results from previous years show.

Above all, the New Year’s Race is a lovely way to get together to round off the old year and have something to talk about at the celebrations later in the day.

You’re welcome too—we’ll see you there!
additional: Please remember that the New Year’s Race is a winter race, and conditions can vary from year to year. In some years, spiked shoes may be recommended.

name: Oskarshamn Backyard 6h
description:
Run a marathon distance in backyard format!

A backyard race lasting 6 hours. One 6.7 km lap each hour for 5 hours. In the 6th hour, one 8.7 km lap. 42.195 km in total. Complete the race and you’ll have run a marathon! The first to finish the final lap wins.

The course mostly follows the exercise trail and is generally accessible, though it has moderate elevation changes.

Registration is via https://raceid.com/sv/races/13769

images.alt_text: Löpare på en skogsstig under Oskarshamn Backyard 6h terränglopp.

name: Tyresö Night Run
description: 10 km, 5 km and kids’ race. The kids’ race is free. See the website for more information.

images.alt_text: Karta över Tyresö Night Run 10 km och 5 km med höjdprofiler.

name: Gävle Adventslopp
description:
Gävle Advent Race is the winter city race that everyone can take part in, young and old, slow and fast.
With this race, we want to inspire the joy of running even during our colder months!

The race starts below the mini-golf course, then runs through beautiful Boulognerskogen and finishes at Boulognerskogen Café, where we serve warm cordial and gingerbread cookies.
Honorary prizes are awarded to the top finishers in each category, and great prizes are also raffled among all participants.

For our youngest runners, we offer the Little Advent Race. The course is 500 m long and starts and finishes near the stage at Boulognerskogen Café.
Before the race, we warm up together with our mascots, the Snowman and the Reindeer.

All information and registration can be found at adventsloppet.se

images.alt_text: Gävle Adventslopp vinterlopp med löpare och julbock.

name: Stockholm Santa Run
description: The best race of the year, with a Santa-red theme! Santa Run is a race of approximately 3 km, or alternatively 6 km, for everyone. You can choose to walk, power walk, jog or run—it’s up to you! Run, walk or roll in a Santa costume to raise money for charity. Join us for the most festive day of the year, filled with community, atmosphere and joy for the whole family in the heart of Stockholm! The whole city is transformed into a running Christmas party, with mulled wine, gingerbread and, of course, a medal for everyone! Buy your place, including a Santa costume, today. All proceeds go to children and young people with disabilities, supporting an active life on their own terms. WELCOME!

images.alt_text: Affisch för Stockholm Santa Run med texten "Your steps Their hope" och en tomte.

name: Nora Marathon
description:
A hilly marathon, most of which is run on asphalt, but also includes gravel roads.
You run four laps.
If you choose the half marathon, you run two laps, and if you choose the quarter marathon, you run one.

pipeline_log.message: New race date found on official site (https://www.ifknora.com/Nora_Marathon/Inbjudan%202027_tidig.htm): 2027-03-20 — "Nora Marathon 2027 kommer att arrangeras lördag 20/3 med gemensam start klockan 10:00." (was estimated 2026-03-21)
pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Nora Marathon 2027 kommer att arrangeras lördag 20/3 med gemensam start klockan 10:00.

name: STHLM Trail Marathon
description:
A warm welcome to the second edition of STHLM TRAIL MARATHON
All races take place on a very scenic course, approximately 15 km long. Each lap will offer you nearly 500 metres of elevation gain. Expect beautiful views and challenging running, mostly over hilly terrain and mostly on trails, sometimes off-trail, but also on a couple of gentler sections where you can stretch out and run for a few hundred metres.

New for 2026
• Be on the start line as early as April! This time we’re holding the event in early spring, so mark 18 April in your calendar now.
• Kids Trail, a free race for our younger runners (born in 2014 or later).
• Hjärnloppet, a virtual race lasting 18 days, where the entire entry fee goes directly to Hjärnfonden and vital research into epilepsy.
• Course preview runs. On two occasions, we’ll run through the first and second parts of the course.
• Virtual running sessions in the Heyey app to help you stay in shape all the way to the start line in April.

What’s not new for 2026
• The course, a challenging and very scenic route in the area around Lake Flaten.
• Sprint and Ultra, two trail races that challenge you a little extra.
• Grit, the ultimate test, which we don’t think anyone can complete. If you prove us wrong, you’ll win both honour and fame, as well as some prize money.
additional: All information on the organiser’s website

images.alt_text: Löpare i STHLM Trail Marathon, en vacker och tuff terränglöpning.

name: MRC Finspång Loop Trail Ultra
description: A tough and challenging low-key trail ultra on a 10 km loop with 400 m of elevation gain. After five loops, you’ll have covered the ultra distance of 50 km and 2,000 m of elevation gain. Technical trail running on singletrack and animal trails through dramatic forest! Welcome!
course_highlights: Very technical terrain on animal trails and narrow single tracks
Five loops of 10 km with ~400 m climb per loop (50 km / ~2000 m total)
Possible thin morning snow that thaws as the sun rises (seasonal conditions)
additional: More information is available on Instagram

name: Tolvanloppet
description: Tolvanloppet is a well-established race for all ages, with children’s races in the morning and adult races at 12:30. Choose between two distances, 6 or 12 kilometres, with or without timing. The course is as beautiful as it is challenging (it’s not entirely flat…), with the start and finish on Ålstensgatan, giving it perhaps the most impressive start straight in Swedish running. In between, you’ll run along the streets of Bromma, with the feeling of running through gardens in apple blossom. The experience is enhanced by the many neighbours who come out to cheer, or even set up their own small refreshment stations or sprinklers—each offering its own kind of cooling relief. All this has helped inspire the race’s slogan: Stockholm’s most charming running race.

images.alt_text: Deltagare springer i ett löparevenemang längs en trädkantad gata.
Familj springer Tolvanloppet förbi en spårvagn på Brommas gator.

name: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet 10K
description: Saucony Djurgårdsvarvet is the most generous race of the year, where the joy of running meets the beautiful scenery of Djurgården. The course winds along gravel and asphalt roads, offering a wonderful mix of challenge and enjoyment. The first 600 people to register will receive a specially designed T-shirt, and after crossing the finish line, a relaxing After Run awaits with a barbecue and non-alcoholic drinks from Bryggmästarens. A portion of the registration fee also goes to Sweden for UNHCR, so every step counts—for you and for someone in need.

name: Coop Eskilstunarunt
description: A flat course with no hills, offering the chance to achieve good times along the river in central Eskilstuna. Start and finish in the city park.

images.alt_text: Starten av Coop Eskilstunarunt, ett terränglopp i centrala Eskilstuna.
Coop Eskilstunarunt startportal med löpare i parken.

Deltagare i Coop Eskilstunarunt som springer under startbågen i stadsparken.

name: Altorp Ultra
description:
Join us for an epic day.
Altorp 6.7 km loop – “Långa gula”.
~120m of elevation per loop.
May 10 2025, between 10:00 and 18:00.
Run as many laps as you can in 8 hours.
Go further than you think.
Challenge yourself, your friends and family.

images.alt_text: Skogsstig med solljus som silar genom träden, perfekt för terränglöpning.
Skogsstig med solljus som strilar ner genom träden.
En skogsstig med en gul markör på ett träd, perfekt för terränglöpning.

name: UppLoppet
description: On 6 June 2026, we invite you to UppLoppet—a wonderful running event with 3 km and 10 km distances, filled with the joy of running, community and a festive atmosphere. Whether you’re aiming for a personal best, want to run at a relaxed pace or simply enjoy the atmosphere, UppLoppet is for you. In addition to the race, we’re offering several enjoyable activities for both participants and spectators. Welcome to celebrate movement, health and community with us on National Day!

images.alt_text: Löpare med svenska flaggor springer, UppLoppet 3 km & 10 km, 6 juni.

name: Sandviken Halvmaraton
description: The first edition of Sandviken Half Marathon—be part of making history! 21.1 km around Sandviken, alongside meadows, lakes, and lovely residential areas. The course has an elevation gain of just 74 m, with the start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken, where there will be something for the whole family to do.
additional: The first edition of Sandviken Half Marathon—be part of making history! 21.1 km around Sandviken, alongside meadows, lakes, and lovely residential areas. The course has an elevation gain of just 74 m, with the start and finish in Stadsparken Sandviken, where there will be something for the whole family to do.

images.alt_text: Sandviken Halvmaraton logotyp med texten "GÄSTRIKELAND 2026 SANDVIKEN HALV-MARATHON"

name: Hoby Backyard Ultra 12H
description: The first edition of Hoby Backyard Ultra 12h! The course is 6,706 m, with approximately 50% trail/gravel road and 50% asphalt. 57 metres of elevation gain per lap.
additional: The start is in Ekebacken in Bräkne-Hoby.

name: Stora Sköndalsvarvet
description: A beautiful 5-kilometre course (5,100 metres) on roads and trails, starting at Stora Sköndal, passing through the Orhem allotment area and Flatens Nature Reserve. Hilly in places.
additional: Bag drop and race bib collection from 16:30; warm-up at 17:15. No start waves.

images.alt_text: Luftfoto över Stora Sköndal med texten "Stora Sköndalsvarvet"

name: Västerås Marathon
description:
NEW RACE 2026

Västerås Marathon offers three distances — 42 km, 21 km and 10 km — on a flat, fast course through the heart of the city and along the beautiful shores of Lake Mälaren. The course is a loop course, with 10 km per lap.
Experience the joy of running in a well-organised race for all levels.

The race is for everyone who enjoys running, from beginners to elite athletes. All ages and paces are welcome, and generous time limits will be set for completing the race.

A warm welcome!

images.alt_text: Affisch för Västerås Marathon 2026 med löpare och en glad gurka.
Västerås Marathon 2026 med löpare, publik och stadssilhuett.
Västerås Marathon logotyp med löpare och en gurka.

name: Vilniaus Kroso Pirmenybė
description: The Open Vilnius District Cross-Country Championships took place on November 14 in Nemenčinė, at the biathlon shooting range. They were organized by the Culture, Sports and Tourism Department of Vilnius District Municipality together with the Vilnius District Municipality Sports School. Athletes from various districts of Lithuania took part, while the youngest participants competed in the 150 m “Olympic Hopes” race. After the finish, the children received medals, and trophies were presented to the best performers. The competition was held in different age groups, with participants covering distances from 150 m to 5,000 m.

images.alt_text: Vaikų krosas starto linijoje po starto arką.
Vaikai ant podiumo su taurėmis Atvirose Vilniaus rajono kroso pirmenybėse.

name: Gintarinė jūrmylė Krosas
description: The international running competition “Gintarinė jūrmylė 2024” will take place in Klaipėda on October 12, 2024. Participants can choose the 8 km distance, which starts at 13:10 from the Giruliai TV Tower. The route follows the bicycle path, and runners will turn toward Liepų Street by the Summer Concert Stage.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo varžybų „Gintarinė jūrmylė“ nuotraukos, bėgikai, podiumas, žiūrovai.
Gintarinė jūrmylė 2024 bėgimo marškinėliai su logotipu.
Bėgikai su numeriais priešais reklaminius stendus.

name: Gintarinė jūrmylė
description: “Gintarinė jūrmylė 2025” will take place in beautiful Smiltynė, with the start and finish at the Sports and Wellness Base. Entry is free for participants under 20 and LLAF members if they register by 11 p.m. on October 8. Registration on October 9 until 3 p.m. costs 5 euros. The race covers 3 nautical miles (5.55 km – one lap) for women and junior girls, and 6 nautical miles (11.11 km – two laps) for men and junior boys.

images.alt_text: Bėgikas su numeriu bėga miško taku.
Gintarinė jūrmylė Klaipėda bėgimo varžybų logotipas su bėgančiais žmonėmis.

name: Vilnius 700 Ultra
description: The “Vilnius 700 Ultra” run will take place in Vingis Park on October 12, 2024. The event’s partners are the Amatininkų klubas “Dvaro meistrai.” Race bibs will be issued on race day from 8:00. All distances will start at 9:00, and the time limit for the 70 km and 70 km relay races is 8 hours. The winners and prizewinners will be awarded at 17:00.

images.alt_text: Vilnius 700 renginio nuotrauka su Gedimino bokštu naktį.
Bėgimas Vilnius 700 Ultra plaktas. Informacija apie bėgimo vieta, distancijas ir datą.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų krosų taurės 5 etapas
location: Ukmergė, Ukmergė district municipality, Vilnius County, Lithuania
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event aimed at promoting running, cycling and orienteering in nature. The competitions take place in Ukmergė, with participants competing in cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling and rogaining. The event encourages active leisure for people of all ages and young people’s interest in sport. The race starts at the stadium of Šilas Progymnasium, and the time limit is 120 minutes (except for Mini Rogaining).
course_highlights: The competitions take place in nature in Ukmergė
The courses include cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling and rogaining
Time limit: 120 minutes (except for Mini Rogaining)
additional: Race bibs and timing chips are distributed at the start venue from 16:30 to 17:30. Maps for the rogaining event are handed out to participants at 17:45, and the start is at 18:00. All groups have a joint start, with the same start time at every stage. All residents and visitors to the city of Ukmergė may take part after completing the participant form and having a health check. Participants can expect competitions for various age groups, registration and health checks, as well as results and course descriptions.

name: Ukmergės fabrikų kroso taurė
description: The Ukmergė Factory Cross-Country Cup 2026 is a five-stage sporting event featuring cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling and rogaining competitions. The event takes place in Kopūstėliai Forest in Ukmergė and aims to encourage active outdoor leisure and promote sport among participants of all ages. All categories have a shared evening start, and participants compete in age groups and event types. The main organiser is VšĮ Sportas miške, and the event is supported by several Ukmergė businesses.
course_highlights: The competitions take place in Kopūstėliai Forest in Ukmergė
Five stages featuring cross-country running, MTB cross-country cycling and rogaining
Evening start; time limit of 120 minutes, except for Mini Rogaining
additional: Race bibs and timing chips will be issued at the start area from 16:30 to 17:30. Maps for the rogaining event will be distributed to participants at 17:45; the start is at 18:00. The time limit is 120 minutes, except for Mini Rogaining. All categories share the same start, which is the same at every stage. Participants register with a health check and consent; competition categories are divided by age and activity level.

name: Kaišiadorių maratonas 2026
description: Kaišiadorys Marathon 2026 is the first marathon to be organized in Kaišiadorys. It will take place on October 10, 2026. The event marks the beginning of a new tradition, bringing together runners from Lithuania and abroad. The marathon will be held in an active, sporty city known for its sporting events and active lifestyle. The event is organized by BK “Kaišiadorys bėga,” Kaišiadorys District Municipality, the Kaišiadorys Education and Sports Center, and VšĮ “Maratomanija.”
course_highlights: Race distances: 42.195 km, half marathon 21.098 km, 10.6 km, 5 km, 2 km, 400 m
Start and finish at Teofilio Matulionio Square in Kaišiadorys
10.6 km loop with a GPX file link for course planning
additional: Race bib distribution begins at 8:00. The marathon, half marathon, and 10.6 km races start at 10:00. The 400 m children’s race starts at 13:30. Time limits: 6 hours for the marathon, 3 hours for the half marathon, 2 hours for 10.6 km, and 1 hour for 5 km. Nordic walking distances have a 6-hour limit. Awards will be presented after each distance finishes. The event venue is Teofilio Matulionio Square, Kaišiadorys; registration and race rules are described in the event regulations.

organizer: Klaipėdos miesto sporto bėgimo klubas “Gintarinė jūrmylė”

description: “Amber Sea Mile” is an international running competition held in beautiful Smiltynė. The event offers various distances: 0.5 nautical miles for children, 1 nautical mile for anyone who wishes to participate, 3 nautical miles for women, and 6 nautical miles for men and professionals. The start and finish are at the Sports and Wellness Centre, and participants are served soldiers’ porridge and tea. The competition tradition commemorates winners’ names on a memorial stone raised from the bottom of the lagoon.
course_highlights: The course takes place in beautiful Smiltynė, starting and finishing at the Sports and Wellness Centre
Distances: 0.5, 1, 3 and 6 nautical-mile races, according to age and gender groups
A memorial stone bearing winners’ names, raised from the bottom of the lagoon
additional: Race bibs are issued on October 10 from 10:15 at the Secretariat. The event opens at 12:30 on October 10. All participants are served soldiers’ porridge and tea. Registration is open until October 8 at 15:00; registration will not be available on October 9 or on race day. Age groups and distances are assigned according to year of birth and gender. Ferry schedule for participants: www.keltas.lt. The event takes place on October 10, 2026, with the start at the Smiltynė nature spot. Participants register online, and the courses include 1, 3 and 6 nautical-mile distances.

name: Jonavos bėgimo taurė 5 etapas
description: On the evening of August 21, the Jonava Sports Center invited running enthusiasts to the fourth stage of the Jonava Running Cup. This time, participants took on a scenic 7 km course in the village of Panoteriai. This August was a special one for the village, marking the 115th anniversary of Panoteriai School and the 30th anniversary of the consecration of the Church of the Discovery of the Holy Cross. Although heavy rain accompanied the runners, it did not dampen the festive atmosphere—the awards ceremony was held inside the Panoteriai church.

Bėgikai po lenktynių su LBMA ir Bėgimo klubo vėliava.

name: Bėgam už Kalvarijos XI
description: Let’s Run for Kalvarija — a road race through the city streets, taking place on Sodų St., Klimo St., Dariaus ir Girėno St. and Laisvės St. The start and finish are by the Independence Monument on Laisvės St.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo lenktynės Kalvarijoje žiemos metu. Bėgikai bėga snieguotu keliu.
Bėgikas kerta finišo liniją Kalvarijos gatvių bėgime.
Kalvarijos Nepriklausomybės paminklas, bėgimo starto ir finišo vieta.

name: Juozo Songailos Run
description: September 15, 2024.!!! Mark this day on your calendar!!! This is an event where we will celebrate the long sporting career of Juozas Songaila, Ukmergė’s most famous runner! You can choose from the following distances: running—a marathon, half marathon, 7 km, 3 km, and 400 m (children’s race); Nordic walking—a half marathon and 7 km. Every participant who completes their distance will receive a wonderfully beautiful, one-of-a-kind medal!

images.alt_text: Juozo Songailos 70-mečio bėgimo renginio plakatas su bėgiku.
Du vyrai su medaliu Juozo Songailos bėgimo proga. Fone matomas renginio pavadinimas.
Bėgikas bėga per rūką, apšviestas mėlyna šviesa, atrodo kaip kliūčių ruožas.
Juozas Songaila su trofėjumi, bėgimo entuziastas ir sveikos gyvensenos propaguotojas.

name: Bėgimas Kaune
description: The annual pink ribbon charity run in Kaunas supports breast cancer prevention. It is a short, recreational and fun running course—a joyful, positive celebration of sport decorated with pink costumes, paint, balloons and ribbons. During PINK RUN, both men and women can show their support and love for the women closest to them: their mother, daughter, sister, wife or best friend.

images.alt_text: Rožinis bėgimas Kaune: didelis žmonių būrys rožiniais marškinėliais, scena ir renginio atmosfera.
Rožinis kaspinas ant džinsinio audinio, simbolizuojantis kovą su krūties vėžiu.
Moteris su rožiniu megztiniu ir krepšiu su abstrakčiu piešiniu, skirtu krūties vėžio prevencijai.

name: Molėtai Bėga
description: Molėtai Sports Center together with the Lithuanian Amateur Running Association invites you to the traditional “Molėtai Runs 2024” race, held for the fourth time, on October 20, 2024. The race distances include 3 km (girls/boys, born in 2006 or later), 9 km (women/men, ages 19–44 and 45 and over), and a 400 m course with no age restrictions. The event brings together running enthusiasts and offers the opportunity to participate in various age groups.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo apdovanojimų ceremonija: vyras su taure, ant kurios bėgikų siluetai.
Bėgimo varžybos mieste, matomos pro langą.

name: Vilniaus maratonas
description: The „Rimi“ Vilnius Marathon, taking place on September 8, 2024, will start for the 22nd time in Vilnius, at Cathedral Square. It is Lithuania’s largest running event, attracting professional runners and enthusiasts from across the country and abroad. Participants can choose from a range of distances: 42 km, 21 km 98 m, 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, and a 200 m children’s race.

name: Greičio Ratai
description: Public Institution Nesustabdomas bėgimas (Volvere run running club), together with the Sports Events Association, is organizing 60 m, 1000 m, and 5×1000 m relay races on September 19, 2025, at Vingis Park Stadium. It’s a great opportunity for running enthusiasts to test themselves over various distances and enjoy the spirit of sport.

Bėgikų grupė su vėliavomis, rodanti sporto renginį.

name: Bėgimas "Ateik ir Įveik!"
description: The “Come and Conquer” run is an unforgettable event full of challenges and surprises. The most enduring runners are invited to set off on an adventure through the hills and valleys of Ąžuolynas Park! From a true test of endurance to active entertainment, there’s something for everyone among the different race distances and obstacle courses—whether you’re a thrill-seeker or an enthusiast of active recreation. This year, the run attracted a record number of participants and was held at the KTU Student Campus and in Ąžuolynas Park.

images.alt_text: Bėgimo "Ateik ir Įveik" renginio nuotrauka. Bėgikai starto linijoje.
Sportininkas su Lietuvos vėliava ant kliūčių ruožo.
Bėgiko nuotrauka su medaliu ir marškinėliais su užrašu "Ateik ir Įveik!"

name: Šiaulių Bėgimas
description: The renewed and unique representative Šiauliai Run 2024 will take place on September 22 at 12:00. THE BIG START. The project’s main goal is to promote physical activity and sport by encouraging an active, fulfilling way to spend leisure time, fostering community spirit and a healthy lifestyle. The run will follow the city’s central streets, passing places significant to Šiauliai’s history. It is for people of all ages, from recreational runners to professionals. The program includes a 700 m children’s run, a 1236 m run commemorating the date of the Battle of the Sun, and 5 km and 10 km runs.

Bėgimo dalyviai su medaliais po finišo, po Šiaulių Bėgimo '25.

name: Nidos pusės maratonas
description: The 24th International Nida Half Marathon will take place on September 28, 2024, in Nida. It is organized by the public institution Kuršių Legendos together with Neringa City Municipality and other institutions. Participants can compete in various distances: the Nida Half Marathon (21.098 km), the 5 km YIT Run, and children’s races of 2 km, 0.5 km, and 0.21 km. Registration will take place only when race numbers are issued, and the starting line will be near Sakutis café.

name: Swampman Backyard Ultra
description: Swampman Backyard Ultra is an ultramarathon in which participants must run a distance of 6,706 meters (4.167 miles) in less than one hour. After each lap, the remaining time can be used for rest and food. Every hour, you will return to the starting line and run another lap until only one runner remains. The Lithuanian record is 22 laps, and the world record is 108 laps.

images.alt_text: Backyard Ultra lenktynių logotipas ir trasa.

name: Utenos Hipodromo Maratonas
distance_verbose: Maratonas, Pusmaratonas, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 metrai, 1 km
description: The IV Utena Hippodrome Marathon will take place on September 24, 2023, at Utena Hippodrome, Užpalių g. 97, Utena. Various distances will be offered, giving participants the opportunity to choose what suits them best. The marathon is a great opportunity not only for runners but also for all sports enthusiasts who want to spend an active day outdoors.

name: Bėgimas Sporto Dienai
description: On January 12, 2025, we invite you to the traditional run commemorating Freedom Defenders’ Day on January 13. The race distances and route remain unchanged: the 8-kilometer race starts at 20:00 from the Giruliai TV Tower, and the 3-kilometer race starts at around 20:20 from the Summer Stage. The first 700 participants to finish will receive medals with an exclusive design, and teamsport.lt has prepared prizes for the fastest runners.

name: PINK RUN su Antėja
description: PINK RUN with Antėja is an annual pink ribbon charity run dedicated to the fight against breast cancer and the prevention of this disease. Join our event in the heart of Kaunas—Laisvės Avenue—and run for the women you love. Support the fight against breast cancer by taking part in runs of various distances for both professionals and amateurs. Pink Run with Antėja is more than a run; it is a message that we love them.
